2904.name: A Fine Mess
objectivesText: Escort Kernobee to the Clockwerk Run exit and then report to Scooty in Booty Bay.

2932.name: Grim Message
objectivesText: Gather Witherbark Skulls and place on Nimboya's Pike. Place Nimboya's Laden Pike at one of the Witherbark Villages in the Hinterlands, then return to Nimboya in Stranglethorn.

2933.name: Venom Bottles

2934.name: Undamaged Venom Sac

2935.name: Consult Master Gadrin
objectivesText: Speak with Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.

2936.name: The Spider God
objectivesText: Read from the Tablet of Theka to learn the name of the Witherbark spider god, then return to Master Gadrin.

2937.name: Summoning Shadra
objectivesText: Defeat Shadra at the altar of Shadra'Alor, then bring her venom to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.

2938.name: Venom to the Undercity
objectivesText: Bring Faranell's Parcel to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.

2945.name: Grime-Encrusted Ring
objectivesText: Figure out a way to remove the grime from the Grime-Encrusted Ring.

2949.name: Return of the Ring
objectivesText: You may either keep the ring, or you may find the person responsible for the imprint and engravings on the inside of the band.

2950.name: Nogg's Ring Redo
objectivesText: Bring the Brilliant Gold Ring, a Silver Bar, a Moss Agate, and 30 silver coins to Nogg in Orgrimmar.

2951.name: The Sparklematic 5200!
objectivesText: Insert a Grime-Encrusted Item into the Sparklematic 5200, and be sure to have three silver coins to start the machine.

2954.name: The Stone Watcher
objectivesText: Learn the purpose of the Stone Watcher of Norgannon, and then interact with the Uldum Pedestal in the Tanaris desert.

2965.name: Portents of Uldum
objectivesText: Speak with Nara Wildmane on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff.

2966.name: Seeing What Happens
objectivesText: Bring the miniature platinum discs to the gates of Uldum in Tanaris and look for clues as to the connection between the two.

2967.name: Return to Thunder Bluff
objectivesText: Speak with Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff.

2968.name: A Future Task
objectivesText: Speak with Sage Truthseeker in Thunder Bluff.

2973.name: A New Cloak's Sheen
objectivesText: Bring 10 Iridescent Sprite Darter Wings to Krueg Skullsplitter in Camp Mojache.

2974.name: A Grim Discovery

2975.name: The Ogres of Feralas
objectivesText: Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache wants you to kill 10 Gordunni Ogres, 10 Gordunni Ogre-Magi, and 5 Gordunni Brutes.

2976.name: A Grim Discovery
objectivesText: Bring the Crate of Grimtotem Horns to Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar.

2978.name: The Gordunni Scroll

2979.name: Dark Ceremony
objectivesText: Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache wants you to find a Gordunni Orb.

2980.name: The Ogres of Feralas
objectivesText: Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache wants you to kill 10 Gordunni Shaman, 10 Gordunni Warlocks, and 5 Gordunni Maulers.

2981.name: A Threat in Feralas
objectivesText: Belgrom Rockmaul wants you to speak with Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache.

2983.name: Call of Fire
objectivesText: Find Kranal Fiss in the Barrens.

2984.name: Call of Fire

2987.name: Gordunni Cobalt
objectivesText: Orwin Gizzmick in Camp Mojache wants 12 samples of Gordunni Cobalt.

2995.name: Lines of Communication
objectivesText: Oran Snakewrithe in Undercity wants you to travel to the Hinterlands and burn the Highvale Records, Highvale Report, and Highvale Notes.

2996.name: Seeking Strahad

3001.name: Seeking Strahad
objectivesText: Find Strahad Farsan in Ratchet.

3002.name: The Gordunni Orb
objectivesText: Bring the Gordunni Orb to Uthel'nay in the Darkbriar Lodge in Orgrimmar.

3042.name: Troll Temper

3062.name: Dark Heart
objectivesText: Talo Thornhoof in Camp Mojache wants Edana Hatetalon's Dark Heart.

3063.name: Vengeance on the Northspring
objectivesText: Talo Thornhoof wants you to kill 4 Northspring Harpies, 4 Northspring Roguefeathers, 4 Northspring Windcallers, and 4 Northspring Slayers.

3065.name: Simple Tablet

3082.name: Etched Tablet

3083.name: Encrypted Tablet

objectivesText: Read the Etched Note and speak to Lanka Farshot in Red Cloud Mesa.

objectivesText: Read the Rune-Inscribed Note and speak to Meela Dawnstrider in Camp Narache.

3094.name: Verdant Note
objectivesText: Read the Verdant Note and speak to Gart Mistrunner in Camp Narache.

3095.name: Simple Scroll
objectivesText: Read the Simple Scroll and speak to Dannal Stern in Deathknell.

3096.name: Encrypted Scroll
objectivesText: Read the Encrypted Scroll and speak to David Trias in Deathknell.

3097.name: Hallowed Scroll
objectivesText: Read the Hallowed Scroll and speak to Dark Cleric Duesten in the church in Deathknell.

objectivesText: Read the Glyphic Scroll and speak to Isabella in the church in Deathknell.

3099.name: Tainted Scroll
objectivesText: Read the Tainted Scroll and speak to Maximillion in Deathknell.

3121.name: A Strange Request
objectivesText: Take the Shrunken Head to Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar.

3122.name: Return to Witch Doctor Uzer'i
objectivesText: Deliver Neeru's Herb Pouch to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Feralas.

3123.name: Testing the Vessel
objectivesText: Travel to the Hinterlands, and locate the Wildkin. Kill 10, and use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Wildkin.
Bring 10 Wildkin Muiseks and the Muisek Vessel to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Feralas.

3124.name: Hippogryph Muisek
objectivesText: Kill 10 Frayfeather Hippogryphs of any type, then use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture them.

3125.name: Faerie Dragon Muisek
objectivesText: Kill 8 Sprite Darters or Sprite Dragons. Use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Faerie Dragons.

3126.name: Treant Muisek
objectivesText: Kill 3 Wandering Forest Walkers. Use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Treants.

3127.name: Mountain Giant Muisek
objectivesText: Kill 7 Land Walkers or Cliff Giants. Use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Mountain Giants.

3128.name: Natural Materials
objectivesText: Bring 2 Splintered Logs, 6 Encrusted Minerals, 20 pieces of Resilient Sinew, and 40 Metallic Fragments to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Camp Mojache.

3129.name: Weapons of Spirit
objectivesText: Witch Doctor Uzer'i wants you to wait for a moment while he prepares the weapons.

3141.name: Loramus
objectivesText: Listen to Loramus Thalipedes tell his story.

3161.name: Gahz'ridian
objectivesText: Marvon Rivetseeker in Tanaris wants you to collect 30 Gahz'ridian Ornaments.

3221.name: Speak with Renferrel

3261.name: Jorn Skyseer
objectivesText: Speak with Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo.

3281.name: Stolen Silver
objectivesText: Bring the Stolen Silver to Gazrog in the Crossroads.

3301.name: Mura Runetotem
objectivesText: Speak with Mura Runetotem in the Sepulcher.

3321.name: Did You Lose This?
objectivesText: Wait for Trenton to finish his work.

3341.name: Bring the End
objectivesText: Andrew Brownell wants you to kill Amnennar the Coldbringer and return his skull.

3362.name: Thistleshrub Valley
objectivesText: Tran'rek in Gadgetzan wants you to kill 8 Gnarled Thistleshrubs and 8 Thistleshrub Rootshapers.

3369.name: In Nightmares
objectivesText: Bring the Nightmare Shard to Hamuul Runetotem on Elder Rise.

3373.name: The Essence of Eranikus
objectivesText: Place the Essence of Eranikus in the Essence Font located in this lair in the Sunken Temple.

3374.name: The Essence of Eranikus
objectivesText: Bring the Oathstone of Ysera's Dragonflight and the Chained Essence of Eranikus to Itharius in the Swamp of Sorrows. It is there that you will make your choice to aid Ysera's Dragonflight or not.

3376.name: Break Sharptusk!
objectivesText: Bring the head of Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle to Brave Windfeather in Red Cloud Mesa.

3379.name: Shadoweaver
objectivesText: Kill the group of Shadow Silk Poachers that wander the Searing Gorge. Nilith has reason to believe that there are five of them that need to be exterminated. Return to Nilith in the Searing Gorge when this task is complete.

3380.name: The Sunken Temple
objectivesText: Find Marvon Rivetseeker in Tanaris.

3382.name: A Crew Under Fire
objectivesText: Defend Captain Vanessa Beltis, her crew and the Horizon Scout's passengers against the naga attack. Captain Vanessa Beltis must survive.

3385.name: The Undermarket
objectivesText: Slay Trade Master Kovic and his minion Clunk. Retrieve the Trader's Satchel from his corpse and return it to Nilith.

3402.name: The Undermarket
objectivesText: Speak with Vizzklick in Gadgetzan.

3441.name: Divine Retribution
objectivesText: Listen as Kalaran Windblade tells his story.

3442.name: The Flawless Flame
objectivesText: Collect 4 Hearts of Flame and 4 globes of Golem Oil and return the items to Kalaran Windblade.

3443.name: Forging the Shaft
objectivesText: Bring 8 Thorium Plated Daggers to Kalaran Windblade.

3444.name: The Stone Circle
objectivesText: Retrieve the Stone Circle from Marvon Rivetseeker's workshop in Ratchet.

3446.name: Into the Depths
objectivesText: Find the Altar of Hakkar in the Sunken Temple in Swamp of Sorrows.

3447.name: Secret of the Circle
objectivesText: Travel into the Sunken Temple and discover the secret hidden in the circle of statues.

3452.name: The Flame's Casing
objectivesText: Find and return a Symbol of Ragnaros to Kalaran Windblade.

3453.name: The Torch of Retribution
objectivesText: Wait for Kalaran Windblade to complete the Torch of Retribution.

3454.name: The Torch of Retribution
objectivesText: Take the Torch of Retribution.

3462.name: Squire Maltrake
objectivesText: Speak with Squire Maltrake.

3463.name: Set Them Ablaze!
objectivesText: Set the North, South, East, and West Sentry Towers on fire by using the Torch of Retribution inside each of the buildings.

3481.name: Trinkets...
objectivesText: Open the chest.

3501.name: Everything Counts In Large Amounts
objectivesText: Bring Kum'isha Imperfect Draenethyst Fragments and be rewarded for each one you turn in.

3502.name: One Draenei's Junk...
objectivesText: Bring Kum'isha Imperfect Draenethyst Fragments. Any form of monster in the Blasted Lands could be carrying a fragment.

3504.name: Betrayed
objectivesText: Deliver the Sealed Letter to Ag'tor Bloodfist in Azshara.

3505.name: Betrayed
objectivesText: Kill 10 Blood Elf Reclaimers, and 10 Blood Elf Surveyors before seeking out Magus Rimtori's camp. Once you've found it, look for something that might be important to her that can be used to draw her into a fight.

3506.name: Betrayed
objectivesText: Destroy the arcane focusing crystal tied to Magus Rimtori and then slay her. Afterwards, take the Head of Magus Rimtori to Ag'tor Bloodfist in Azshara.

3507.name: Betrayed
objectivesText: Speak to Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar.

3508.name: Breaking the Ward
objectivesText: Wait for Loramus to complete the enlightenment spell.

3509.name: The Name of the Beast
objectivesText: Speak with Lord Arkkoroc in Azshara. Begin your search at the waters edge to find the Temple of Arkkoran.

3510.name: The Name of the Beast
objectivesText: Slay Hetaera and bring back Hetaera's Bloodied Head, Hetaera's Beaten Head, and Hetaera's Bruised Head to Lord Arkkoroc.

3511.name: The Name of the Beast
objectivesText: Take the temper back to Loramus Thalipedes.

3512.name: In Eranikus' Own Words
objectivesText: Travel to the eastern part of Winterspring and speak with Umbranse the Spiritspeaker.

3513.name: The Runed Scroll
objectivesText: Take the Runed Scroll to the northern guard tower in the Barrens.

3514.name: Horde Presence
objectivesText: Kill the leader of the Talon Den, Rynthariel the Keymaster.

3517.name: Stealing Knowledge
objectivesText: Find the Tablet of Beth'Amara, the Tablet of Jin'yael, the Tablet of Markri, and the Tablet of Sael'hai before returning to Jediga in Azshara.

3518.name: Delivery to Magatha
objectivesText: Bring the Tablet of Beth'Amara to Magatha in Thunder Bluff.

3520.name: Screecher Spirits
objectivesText: Capture the spirits of 3 screechers in Feralas, then return to Yeh'kinya in Steamwheedle Port.

3523.name: Scourge of the Downs
objectivesText: If you agree to aid Belnistrasz, speak with him again and hand the Oathstone he gave you back to him.

3525.name: Extinguishing the Idol
objectivesText: Escort Belnistrasz to the Quilboar's idol in Razorfen Downs.
Protect Belnistrasz while he performs the ritual to shut down the idol.

3526.name: Goblin Engineering
objectivesText: If you wish to learn more about Goblin Engineering, take the Manual of Engineering Disciplines to Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan.

3527.name: The Prophecy of Mosh'aru
objectivesText: Bring the First and Second Mosh'aru Tablets to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.

3528.name: The God Hakkar
objectivesText: Bring the Filled Egg of Hakkar to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.

3541.name: Delivery to Jes'rimon
objectivesText: Bring the Tablet of Jin'yael to Jes'rimon in Orgrimmar.

3542.name: Delivery to Andron Gant
objectivesText: Bring the Tablet of Markri to Andron Gant in Undercity.

3561.name: Delivery to Archmage Xylem
objectivesText: Bring the Tablet of Sael'hai to Archmage Xylem in Azshara.

3562.name: Magatha's Payment to Jediga
objectivesText: Deliver Magatha's Note to Jediga in Azshara.

3563.name: Jes'rimon's Payment to Jediga
objectivesText: Deliver Jes'rimon's Note to Jediga in Azshara.

3564.name: Andron's Payment to Jediga
objectivesText: Deliver Andron's Note to Jediga in Azshara.

3565.name: Xylem's Payment to Jediga
objectivesText: Deliver Xylem's Note to Jediga in Azshara.

3568.name: Seeping Corruption
objectivesText: Fill all 4 Empty Vials at the tide pools along the coast of the Ruins of Eldarath in Azshara before returning to Chemist Cuely.

3569.name: Seeping Corruption
objectivesText: Give Cuely's Elixir to Thersa Windsong in Undercity.

3601.name: Kim'jael Indeed!
objectivesText: Search the Thalassian Base Camp for Kim'jael's Compass, Scope, Stuffed Chicken and Wizzlegoober, then return them to him in Azshara.

3602.name: Azsharite
objectivesText: Recover twenty Crystallized Azsharite from southern Azshara. You may use the Felhound to assist you in 'sniffing' out the location of cleverly hidden deposits.
Return to Loramus when the task is complete.

3621.name: The Formation of Felbane
objectivesText: Take the Shipment to Galvan the Ancient in Stranglethorn Vale.

3625.name: Enchanted Azsharite Fel Weaponry
objectivesText: Wait for Galvan to finish forging the weaponry.

3626.name: Return to the Blasted Lands
objectivesText: Return to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.

3627.name: Uniting the Shattered Amulet
objectivesText: Slay Grol the Destroyer, Lady Sevine, and Archmage Allistarj. From their corpses take the Amulet of Grol, the Amulet of Sevine, and the Amulet of Allistarj.
Remember to USE your Enchanted Azsharite Fel Weaponry to weaken the triad. They cannot be killed otherwise - but use them wisely...

3628.name: You Are Rakh'likh, Demon
objectivesText: Destroy Razelikh the Defiler and return the Severed Horn of the Defiler to the Fallen Hero of the Horde. You will also need to return the Ward of the Defiler so that the Fallen Hero can destroy it, preventing it from ever falling into the wrong hands.

3631.name: Summon Felsteed
objectivesText: Speak to Strahad Farsan in the Barrens.

3633.name: Goblin Engineering
objectivesText: If you wish to learn more about Goblin Engineering, take the Manual of Engineering Disciplines to Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan.

3635.name: Gnome Engineering
objectivesText: If you wish to learn more about Gnome Engineering, take the Manual of Engineering Disciplines to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.

3637.name: Gnome Engineering
objectivesText: If you wish to learn more about Gnome Engineering, take the Manual of Engineering Disciplines to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.

3638.name: The Pledge of Secrecy
objectivesText: If you agree to become a Goblin Engineer, then right-click on the Pledge of Secrecy and speak once more with Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan.

3639.name: Show Your Work
objectivesText: Bring 20 Big Iron Bombs, 20 Solid Dynamite, and 5 Explosive Sheep to Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan.

3642.name: The Pledge of Secrecy
objectivesText: If you agree to become a Gnome Engineer, then right-click on the Pledge of Secrecy and speak once more with Oglethrope Obnoticus in Booty bay.

3643.name: Show Your Work
objectivesText: Bring 6 Mithril Tubes, an Accurate Scope, and a 2 Advanced Target Dummies to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.

3741.name: Hilary's Necklace
objectivesText: Find Hilary's Necklace, and return it to Hilary in Lakeshire.

3761.name: Un'Goro Soil
objectivesText: Bring 20 Un'Goro Soil samples to Ghede on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff.

3762.name: Assisting Arch Druid Runetotem
objectivesText: Speak with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.

3782.name: Morrowgrain Research
objectivesText: Take the Seed Voucher to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.

3783.name: Are We There, Yeti?
objectivesText: Collect 10 Thick Yeti Furs for Umi Rumplesnicker in Everlook.

3784.name: Assisting Arch Druid Runetotem
objectivesText: Speak with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.

3786.name: Morrowgrain Research
objectivesText: Use an Evergreen Pouch with a Packet of Tharlendis Seeds and two Un'Goro Soil samples to try and cultivate samples of Morrowgrain.
Bring 10 Morrowgrain to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.

3801.name: Dark Iron Legacy
objectivesText: Speak with Franclorn Forgewright if you are interested in obtaining a key to the city major.

3802.name: Dark Iron Legacy
objectivesText: Slay Fineous Darkvire and recover the great hammer, Ironfel. Take Ironfel to the Shrine of Thaurissan and place it on the statue of Franclorn Forgewright.

3821.name: Dreadmaul Rock
objectivesText: Venture forth to the Burning Steppes and find out what became of Sha'ni Proudtusk.

3822.name: Krom'Grul
objectivesText: Recover Sha'ni's Nose-Ring from Krom'Grul and return it to Thal'trak in Kargath. Search the various caves and mines in Dreadmaul Rock.

3844.name: It's a Secret to Everybody
objectivesText: Look around in the pond for a clue about who this wrecked raft may belong to.

3845.name: It's a Secret to Everybody
objectivesText: Examine the items inside the pack and bring them to their owner.

3881.name: Expedition Salvation
objectivesText: Bring a Crate of Foodstuffs and Research Equipment to Williden Marshal in Un'Goro Crater.

3882.name: Roll the Bones
objectivesText: Bring 8 Dinosaur Bones to Spark Nilminer in Un'Goro Crater.

3883.name: Alien Ecology
objectivesText: Use the Scraping Vial to collect a Hive Wall Sample from one of the Gorishi hive hatcheries in Un'Goro Crater. Look for the chambers with the hanging larval spawns.
Bring the Hive Wall Sample to Hol'anyee Marshal in Un'Goro Crater.

3884.name: Williden's Journal
objectivesText: Return the journal to Williden Marshal somewhere in Un'Goro Crater.

3901.name: Rattling the Rattlecages
objectivesText: Kill 12 Rattlecage Skeletons, and then return to Shadow Priest Sarvis in Deathknell when you are done.

3902.name: Scavenging Deathknell
objectivesText: Search Deathknell and the vicinity for 6 pieces of Scavenged Goods, and return them to Deathguard Saltain.

3906.name: Disharmony of Flame
objectivesText: Travel to the quarry in Blackrock Mountain and slay Overmaster Pyron. Return to Thunderheart when you have completed this assignment.

3907.name: Disharmony of Fire
objectivesText: Enter Blackrock Depths and track down Lord Incendius. Slay him and return any source of information you may find to Thunderheart.

3908.name: It's a Secret to Everybody
objectivesText: Take Linken's Sword to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

3909.name: The Videre Elixir
objectivesText: Seek out Gregan Brewspewer in northern Feralas. From him, learn how you may acquire the Videre Elixir, then return to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

3912.name: Meet at the Grave
objectivesText: Go to the graveyard outside Gadgetzan, and use the Videre Elixir. Follow the rest of Donova's instructions to find Gaeriyan.

3913.name: A Grave Situation
objectivesText: Resurrect, then look for the gravestone that Gaeriyan told you to find.

3914.name: Linken's Sword
objectivesText: Deliver Linken's Superior Sword to Linken in Un'Goro Crater.

3921.name: Wenikee Boltbucket
objectivesText: Bring the Broken Samophlange to Wenikee Boltbucket.

3922.name: Nugget Slugs
objectivesText: Bring 15 Nugget Slugs to Wenikee Boltbucket in the Barrens.

3923.name: Rilli Greasygob
objectivesText: Bring the Broken and Battered Samophlange to Rilli Greasygob in Orgrimmar.

3924.name: Samophlange Manual
objectivesText: Bring the Samophlange Manual to Rilli Greasygob in Orgrimmar.

3941.name: A Gnome's Assistance
objectivesText: Find J.D. Collie in the cave at Marshal's Refuge.

3942.name: Linken's Memory
objectivesText: Find Eridan Bluewind in southern Felwood.

3961.name: Linken's Adventure
objectivesText: Take the Silver Totem of Aquementas to Linken in Marshal's Refuge.

3962.name: It's Dangerous to Go Alone
objectivesText: Travel to Fire Plume Ridge, south of Marshal's Refuge.
Find Blazerunner and use the totem to remove his protective aura. Once he has been defeated, acquire the Golden Flame from the cave.

3981.name: Commander Gor'shak
objectivesText: Find Commander Gor'shak in Blackrock Depths.
You recall that the crudely drawn picture of the orc included bars drawn over the portrait. Perhaps you should search for a prison of some sort.

3982.name: What Is Going On?
objectivesText: Defend Gor'shak.

4001.name: What Is Going On?
objectivesText: Speak with Kharan Mighthammer and gather information about Princess Moira Bronzebeard's kidnapping. Take that information to Thrall in Orgrimmar.
You recall Gor'shak mentioning that Kharan is being held in a cell nearby.

4002.name: The Eastern Kingdom
objectivesText: Speak with Thrall if you are prepared to take on the mission he has planned.

4003.name: The Royal Rescue
objectivesText: Slay Emperor Dagran Thaurissan and free Princess Moira Bronzebeard from his evil spell.

4004.name: The Princess Saved?
objectivesText: Return to Thrall!

4005.name: Aquementas
objectivesText: Take the Book of Aquor, the Silvery Claws, and the Irontree Heart to Tanaris.
Use the Book of Aquor to summon Aquementas.
After you have the completed totem, take it to J.D. Collie in Marshal's Refuge.

4021.name: Counterattack!
objectivesText: Bring a Piece of Krom'zar's Banner to Regthar Deathgate, west of the Crossroads.

4022.name: A Taste of Flame
objectivesText: Show Cyrus Therepentous the Black Dragonflight Molt you received from Kalaran Windblade.

4023.name: A Taste of Flame
objectivesText: Show Cyrus Therepentous proof of your worth.
You have a feeling that Cyrus already knows that you are unworthy.

4024.name: A Taste of Flame
objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Depths and slay Bael'Gar.
You only know that the giant resides inside Blackrock Depths. Remember to use the Altered Black Dragonflight Molt on Bael'Gar's remains to capture the Fiery Essence.
Return the Encased Fiery Essence to Cyrus Therepentous.

4061.name: The Rise of the Machines
objectivesText: Venture to the Burning Steppes and recover 10 Fractured Elemental Shards for Hierophant Theodora Mulvadania.
You recall Theodora mentioning the golems and elementals of that region as being a source for these shards.

4062.name: The Rise of the Machines
objectivesText: Take the Elemental Shard Sample to Lotwil Veriatus.
You recall Theodora saying that Lotwil was stationed in a camp to the east.

4063.name: The Rise of the Machines
objectivesText: Find and slay Golem Lord Argelmach. Return his head to Lotwil. You will also need to collect 10 Intact Elemental Cores from the Ragereaver Golems and Warbringer Constructs protecting Argelmach. You know this because you are psychic.

4081.name: KILL ON SIGHT: Dark Iron Dwarves
objectivesText: Venture to Blackrock Depths and destroy the vile aggressors!
Warlord Goretooth wants you to kill 15 Anvilrage Guardsmen, 10 Anvilrage Wardens and 5 Anvilrage Footmen. Return to him once your task is complete.

4082.name: KILL ON SIGHT: High Ranking Dark Iron Officials
objectivesText: Venture to Blackrock Depths and destroy the vile aggressors!
Warlord Goretooth wants you to kill 10 Anvilrage Medics, 10 Anvilrage Soldiers and 10 Anvilrage Officers. Return to him once your task is complete.

4084.name: Silver Heart
objectivesText: Collect 11 Silvery Claws and 1 Irontree Heart for Eridan Bluewind in Felwood.

4102.name: Cleansing Felwood
objectivesText: Bring 15 Blood Amber to Maybess Riverbreeze in Felwood.

4120.name: The Strength of Corruption
objectivesText: Talo Thornhoof at Camp Mojache in Feralas wants you to kill 12 Angerclaw Grizzlies and 12 Felpaw Ravagers in Felwood.

4121.name: Precarious Predicament
objectivesText: Escort your prisoner, Grark Lorkrub, through Burning Steppes and through Blackrock Mountain to the Searing Gorge.
You recall Lexlort mentioning that he would have his men waiting on the other side to take Grark into custody.
You will also be required to hand over your Thorium Shackles to Lexlort.

4122.name: Grark Lorkrub
objectivesText: Travel to the Burning Steppes and find Grark Lorkrub. You recall Lexlort mentioning that he was last seen in a massive Blackrock fortress.

When you find Grark Lorkrub, use the Thorium Shackles to bind him and then lead him back through Blackrock Mountain to the Searing Gorge. Lexlort will have his men waiting on the other side to take Grark into custody.

4123.name: The Heart of the Mountain
objectivesText: Bring the Heart of the Mountain to Maxwort Uberglint in the Burning Steppes.

4132.name: Operation: Death to Angerforge
objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Depths and slay General Angerforge! Return to Warlord Goretooth when the task is complete.

4133.name: Vivian Lagrave
objectivesText: Speak with Shadowmaster Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.

4134.name: Lost Thunderbrew Recipe
objectivesText: Bring the Lost Thunderbrew Recipe to Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.

4136.name: Ribbly Screwspigot
objectivesText: Bring Ribbly's Head to Yuka Screwspigot in the Burning Steppes.

4145.name: Larion and Muigin
objectivesText: Hunt 5 Bloodpetal Lashers, 5 Bloodpetal Threshers, 5 Bloodpetal Flayers and 5 Bloodpetal Trappers for Larion at Marshal's Refuge.

4146.name: Zapper Fuel
objectivesText: Deliver the Unloaded Zapper and 5 samples of Atal'ai Haze to Larion in Marshal's Refuge.

4147.name: Marvon's Workshop
objectivesText: Travel to Marvon Rivetseeker's workshop in Ratchet.

4201.name: The Love Potion
objectivesText: Bring 4 Gromsblood, 10 Giant Silver Veins and Nagmara's Filled Vial to Mistress Nagmara in Blackrock Depths.

4243.name: Chasing A-Me 01
objectivesText: Find A-Me 01 in Un'Goro Crater.

4244.name: Chasing A-Me 01
objectivesText: Find a Mithril Casing and return to A-Me 01 in Un'Goro Crater.

4245.name: Chasing A-Me 01
objectivesText: Escort A-Me 01 back to Karna Remtravel in Un'Goro Crater.

4284.name: Crystals of Power
objectivesText: Collect 7 Power Crystals of each color: red, blue, yellow, and green. Bring them to J.D. Collie at Marshal's Refuge.

4285.name: The Northern Pylon
objectivesText: Discover the location of the Northern Crystal Pylon in Un'Goro Crater.

4287.name: The Eastern Pylon
objectivesText: Discover the location of the Eastern Crystal Pylon in Un'Goro Crater.

4288.name: The Western Pylon
objectivesText: Discover the location of the Western Crystal Pylon.

4289.name: The Apes of Un'Goro
objectivesText: Bring 2 Un'Goro Gorilla Pelts, 2 Un'Goro Stomper Pelts, and 2 Un'Goro Thunderer Pelts to Torwa Pathfinder at the entrance of Un'Goro Crater.

4290.name: The Fare of Lar'korwi
objectivesText: Find the carcass of Lar'korwi's freshest kill and steal a Piece of Threshadon Carcass before returning to Torwa Pathfinder in Un'Goro Crater.

4291.name: The Scent of Lar'korwi
objectivesText: Bring 2 Ravasaur Pheromone Glands to Torwa Pathfinder near the entrance to Un'Goro Crater.

4292.name: The Bait for Lar'korwi
objectivesText: Using the contents of Torwa's Pouch, summon Lar'korwi and defeat him. Then bring Lar'korwi's Head to Torwa Pathfinder near the entrance to Un'Goro Crater.

4293.name: A Sample of Slime...
objectivesText: Gather Felwood Slime Samples from any of the slimes in Felwood. Then, using the Testing Equipment next to Chemist Fuely in Undercity, see which of your samples are the most corrupt. Bring 5 of the Corrupted Felwood Samples you find to Chemist Fuely.

4294.name: ... and a Batch of Ooze
objectivesText: Gather Un'Goro Slime Samples from any of the slimes in Un'Goro Crater. Then, using the Testing Equipment next to Chemist Fuely in Undercity, see which of your samples are the most pure. Bring 5 of the Pure Un'Goro Samples you find to Chemist Fuely.

4296.name: Tablet of the Seven
objectivesText: Bring the Tablet Transcript to Maxwort Uberglint in the Burning Steppes.

4300.name: Bone-Bladed Weapons
objectivesText: Bring 8 White Ravasaur Claws to Jes'rimon in Orgrimmar.

4301.name: The Mighty U'cha
objectivesText: Bring U'cha's Pelt to Torwa Pathfinder at the entrance of Un'Goro Crater.

4321.name: Making Sense of It
objectivesText: Speak with J.D. Collie in a moment.

4324.name: Yuka Screwspigot
objectivesText: Speak with Yuka Screwspigot in the Burning Steppes.

4402.name: Galgar's Cactus Apple Surprise
objectivesText: Bring Galgar 10 Cactus Apples. You remember him saying that they could be found near cactuses.

4449.name: Caught!
objectivesText: Kill 8 Dark Iron Geologists and bring 15 pieces of Silk Cloth to the person locked in the outhouse in Searing Gorge.

4450.name: Ledger from Tanaris
objectivesText: Take the copy of Goodsteel's Ledger and then find the items listed in it before seeking Krinkle Goodsteel in Tanaris.

4451.name: The Key to Freedom
objectivesText: Search Searing Gorge and find a use for the Grimesilt Outhouse Key you have found.

4489.name: Summon Felsteed
objectivesText: Speak to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet.

4490.name: Summon Felsteed
objectivesText: Speak to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet to learn the ability to summon a Felsteed.

4491.name: A Little Help From My Friends
objectivesText: Lead Ringo to Spraggle Frock at Marshal's Refuge.
If Ringo faints, use Spraggle's Canteen to revive him.

4492.name: Lost!
objectivesText: Find Ringo at Fire Plume Ridge.

4494.name: March of the Silithid
objectivesText: Speak to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan.

4496.name: Bungle in the Jungle
objectivesText: Bring a Gorishi Scent Gland and 5 Un'Goro Soil samples to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan.

4501.name: Beware of Pterrordax
objectivesText: Kill 10 Pterrordax and 15 Frenzied Pterrordax, then speak to Spraggle Frock at Marshal's Refuge.

4502.name: Volcanic Activity
objectivesText: Collect 9 samples of Un'Goro Ash from the fire elementals around the volcano in Un'Goro Crater, and return them to Liv Rizzlefix in Ratchet.

4503.name: Shizzle's Flyer
objectivesText: Collect 8 Webbed Diemetradon Scales and 8 Webbed Pterrordax Scales for Shizzle in Marshal's Refuge.

4504.name: Super Sticky
objectivesText: Collect 12 samples of Super Sticky Tar for Tran'rek in Gadgetzan.

4505.name: Well of Corruption
objectivesText: Collect a sample of corrupted water from the Jadefire Satyrs' moonwell and bring it to Winna Hazzard at Bloodvenom Post.

4506.name: Corrupted Sabers
objectivesText: Take Winna's kitten to the corrupted moonwell, release it, then bring it back to Winna.
Once you have returned to Winna, click on the cat to release it to Winna.

4507.name: Pawn Captures Queen
objectivesText: Defeat the Gorishi Hive Queen once she is summoned.
Bring the Gorishi Queen's Brain to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan.

4509.name: Calm Before the Storm
objectivesText: Bring Pestlezugg's Un'Goro Report to Zilzibin Drumlore in Orgrimmar.

4511.name: Calm Before the Storm
objectivesText: Bring the Bank Voucher to Karus in the bank of Orgrimmar.

4521.name: Wild Guardians
objectivesText: Trull Failbane in Felwood wants you to kill 15 Raging Owlbeasts and 15 Ragged Owlbeasts.

4542.name: Message to Freewind Post
objectivesText: Bring the Urgent Message to Cliffwatcher Longhorn at Freewind Post.

4601.name: The Sparklematic 5200!
objectivesText: Insert a Grime-Encrusted Item into the Sparklematic 5200, and be sure to have three silver coins to start the machine.

4602.name: The Sparklematic 5200!
objectivesText: Insert a Grime-Encrusted Item into the Sparklematic 5200, and be sure to have three silver coins to start the machine.

4621.name: Avast Ye, Admiral!
objectivesText: Slay Fleet Master Seahorn and Baron Revilgaz of Booty Bay, and then return to Fleet Master Firallon aboard the Crimson Veil off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale.

4641.name: Your Place In The World
objectivesText: Speak with Gornek. You recall Kaltunk marking your map with his location and mentioning that Gornek resided in the Den, a building to the west.

4642.name: Melding of Influences
objectivesText: Bring a Merged Ooze Sample to Chemist Fuely in Undercity.

4721.name: Wild Guardians
objectivesText: Trull Failbane in Felwood wants you to hunt 10 Berserk Owlbeasts in Winterspring.

4724.name: The Pack Mistress
objectivesText: Slay Halycon, pack mistress of the Bloodaxe worg.

4726.name: Broodling Essence
objectivesText: Bring 8 Broodling Essence and the Draco-Incarcinatrix 900 to Tinkee Steamboil at the Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.

4729.name: Kibler's Exotic Pets
objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Spire and find Bloodaxe Worg Pups. Use the cage to carry the ferocious little beasts. Bring back a Caged Worg Pup to Kibler.

4734.name: Egg Freezing
objectivesText: Use the Eggscilloscope Prototype on an egg in the Rookery.

4735.name: Egg Collection
objectivesText: Bring 8 Collected Dragon Eggs and the Collectronic Module to Tinkee Steamboil at Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.

4737.name: In Search of Menara Voidrender
objectivesText: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4739.name: In Search of Menara Voidrender
objectivesText: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4741.name: Wild Guardians
objectivesText: Trull Failbane in Felwood wants you to hunt 13 Moontouched Owlbeasts.

4742.name: Seal of Ascension
objectivesText: Find the three gemstones of command: The Gemstone of Smolderthorn, Gemstone of Spirestone, and Gemstone of Bloodaxe. Return them, along with the Unadorned Seal of Ascension, to Vaelan.
The Generals, as told to you by Vaelan, are: War Master Voone of the Smolderthorn; Highlord Omokk of the Spirestone; and Overlord Wyrmthalak of the Bloodaxe.

4743.name: Seal of Ascension
objectivesText: Travel to the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh. Find the ancient drake, Emberstrife and beat him without mercy until his will is broken.

It is at that moment which you must place the Unforged Seal of Ascension before the great beast. You must then be quick to use the Orb of Draconic Energy on his weakened form and claim dominion over his mental faculties. Control the beast and force the Flames of the Black Dragonflight upon the Unforged Seal of Ascension!

4767.name: Wind Rider
objectivesText: Bring 10 Highperch Wyvern Eggs to Elu in Freewind Post.

4768.name: The Darkstone Tablet
objectivesText: Bring the Darkstone Tablet to Shadow Mage Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.

4769.name: Vivian Lagrave and the Darkstone Tablet
objectivesText: Speak with Shadowmage Vivian Lagrave.

4770.name: Homeward Bound
objectivesText: Escort Pao'ka Swiftmountain from Highperch, and then talk to Motega Firemane in Whitereach Post.

4771.name: Dawn's Gambit
objectivesText: Place Dawn's Gambit in the Viewing Room of the Scholomance. Defeat Vectus, then return to Betina Bigglezink.

4781.name: Components for the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe
objectivesText: Bring a Gold Bar to Xizk Goodstitch in Stranglethorn Vale.

4782.name: Components for the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe
objectivesText: Return to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4783.name: Components for the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe
objectivesText: Bring 10 Vials of Hatefury Blood and 1 Lesser Infernal Stone to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4784.name: Components for the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe
objectivesText: Bring some Fine Gold Thread, 2 Smoldering Coals, and a Soul Shard to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4786.name: The Completed Robe
objectivesText: Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete your robe and then speak to her again.

4787.name: The Ancient Egg
objectivesText: Bring the Ancient Egg to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.

4788.name: The Final Tablets
objectivesText: Bring the Fifth and Sixth Mosh'aru Tablets to Prospector Ironboot in Tanaris.

4808.name: Felnok Steelspring
objectivesText: Give Tinkee's Letter to Felnok Steelspring.

4809.name: Chillwind Horns
objectivesText: Bring 8 Uncracked Chillwind Horns to Felnok Steelspring.

4810.name: Return to Tinkee
objectivesText: Bring Felnok's Package to Tinkee Steamboil in the Burning Steppes.

4821.name: Alien Egg
objectivesText: Return the Alien Egg to Hagar Lightninghoof in Freewind Post.

4841.name: Pacify the Centaur
objectivesText: Kill 12 Galak Scouts, 10 Galak Wranglers, and 6 Galak Windchasers, and then return to Cliffwatcher Longhorn in Freewind Post.

4842.name: Strange Sources
objectivesText: Follow Donova Snowden's instructions, then report back.

4862.name: En-Ay-Es-Tee-Why
objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Spire and collect 15 Spire Spider Eggs for Kibler.
By the sound of it, these eggs could be found near spiders.

4865.name: Serpent Wild
objectivesText: Report your findings to Motega Firemane.

4866.name: Mother's Milk
objectivesText: In the heart of Blackrock Spire you will find Mother Smolderweb. Engage her and get her to poison you. Chances are good that you will have to kill her as well. Return to Ragged John when you are poisoned so that he can 'milk' you.

4867.name: Urok Doomhowl
objectivesText: Read Warosh's Scroll. Bring Warosh's Mojo to Warosh.

4881.name: Assassination Plot
objectivesText: Warn Kanati Greycloud at Whitereach Post of the plot to kill him.

4882.name: Guarding Secrets
objectivesText: Take the Blue-feathered Necklace to Trull Failbane at Bloodvenom Post.

4883.name: Guarding Secrets
objectivesText: Take the Blue-feathered Necklace to Nara Wildmane.

4903.name: Warlord's Command
objectivesText: Slay Highlord Omokk, War Master Voone, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Recover Important Blackrock Documents. Return to Warlord Goretooth in Kargath when the mission has been accomplished.

4904.name: Free at Last
objectivesText: Escort Lakota Windsong from the Darkcloud Pinnacle, and then talk to Thalia Amberhide at Freewind Post.

4907.name: Tinkee Steamboil
objectivesText: Speak with Tinkee Steamboil.

4921.name: Lost in Battle
objectivesText: Find Mankrik's wife and then return to him in the Crossroads.

4941.name: Eitrigg's Wisdom
objectivesText: Speak with Eitrigg in Orgrimmar. When you have discussed matters with Eitrigg, seek council from Thrall.
You recall having seen Eitrigg in Thrall's chamber.

4961.name: Cleansing of the Orb of Orahil
objectivesText: Kill the Demon of the Orb, then speak with Tabetha.

4962.name: Shard of a Felhound
objectivesText: Take the Felhas Ruby and use it on one of the Felhounds found in Desolace. After successful, bring the Felhas Ruby and the Imprisoned Felhound Spirit back to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4963.name: Shard of an Infernal
objectivesText: Take the Infus Emerald and use it on one of the Infernals found in Desolace. After successful, bring the Infus Emerald and the Imprisoned Infernal Spirit back to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4964.name: The Completed Orb of Dar'Orahil
objectivesText: Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete the Orb of Dar'Orahil and then speak to her again.

4966.name: Protect Kanati Greycloud
objectivesText: Protect Kanati Greycloud from the centaur attack.

4967.name: Knowledge of the Orb of Orahil
objectivesText: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4969.name: Knowledge of the Orb of Orahil
objectivesText: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4971.name: A Matter of Time
objectivesText: Use the Temporal Displacer near one of Andorhal's silos and uncover Temporal Parasites.
Slay 10 Temporal Parasites, and then return the Temporal Displacer to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, Western Plaguelands.

4972.name: Counting Out Time
objectivesText: Locate 5 Andorhal Watches, found in lockboxes amongst the rubble of the city. Return with them to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, Western Plaguelands.

4973.name: Counting Out Time
objectivesText: Locate 5 Andorhal Watches amongst the rubble of the city, and return with them to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, Western Plaguelands.

4974.name: For The Horde!
objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay Warchief Rend Blackhand. Take his head and return to Orgrimmar.

4975.name: The Completed Orb of Noh'Orahil
objectivesText: Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete the Orb of Noh'Orahil and then speak to her again.

4976.name: Returning the Cleansed Orb
objectivesText: Return the Cleansed Infernal Orb to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4981.name: Operative Bijou
objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Spire and find out what happened to Bijou.

4982.name: Bijou's Belongings
objectivesText: Find Bijou's Belongings and return them to her. You recall her mentioning that she stashed them on the bottom floor of the city.

4983.name: Bijou's Reconnaissance Report
objectivesText: Take Bijou's Reconnaissance Report back to Grandmaster Lexlort in Kargath.

4984.name: The Wildlife Suffers Too
objectivesText: Destroy 8 Diseased Wolves, and then return to Mulgris Deepriver at the Writhing Haunt, Western Plaguelands.

4985.name: The Wildlife Suffers Too
objectivesText: Destroy 8 Diseased Grizzlies, and then return to Mulgris Deepriver at the Writhing Haunt, Western Plaguelands.

4987.name: Glyphed Oaken Branch
objectivesText: Based on the magic enchanted within the Glyphed Oaken Branch, its delivery to the Cenarion Circle in Thunder Bluff is the next step the tauren druid sought. Seek one of the druids there for assistance.

5021.name: Better Late Than Never
objectivesText: The ramblings of the ghostly woman indicated that she needed a package delivered. She claimed that it was where her horse was. As to where the horse is or where the package was to be delivered - the ghost remains incomprehensible.

5023.name: Better Late Than Never
objectivesText: Check with the Royal Overseers of the Undercity to learn the whereabouts of a Jeremiah Felstone. There is usually a census officer located near guild and tabard registration.

5041.name: Supplies for the Crossroads
objectivesText: Find and return Crossroads' Supply Crates to Thork in the Barrens.

5047.name: Pip Quickwit, At Your Service!
objectivesText: Talk to Malyfous Darkhammer in Everlook.

5049.name: The Jeremiah Blues
objectivesText: Find Jeremiah Payson in the Undercity and see if he is in fact Jeremiah Felstone. If he is, then perhaps he'd like the package Janice Felstone made for him.

5050.name: Good Luck Charm
objectivesText: Return to Janice Felstone in Western Plaguelands her Good Luck Half-Charm.

5051.name: Two Halves Become One
objectivesText: Locate the other half of the Good Luck Charm somewhere on the Felstone Farm in Western Plaguelands and reassemble it.
Give the Good Luck Charm to Janice Felstone on the Felstone Farm, Western Plaguelands.

5052.name: Blood Shards of Agamaggan
objectivesText: Bring a Blood Shard to Mangletooth in Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.
Collect more Blood Shards if you want him to bless you with Agamaggan's power.

5054.name: Ursius of the Shardtooth
objectivesText: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to kill Ursius.

5055.name: Brumeran of the Chillwind
objectivesText: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to kill Brumeran.

5056.name: Shy-Rotam
objectivesText: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to defeat Shy-Rotam.

5062.name: Sacred Fire
objectivesText: Gather 10 bushels of Incendia Agave, and then consult Magatha Grimtotem on Elder Rise in Thunderbluff.

5063.name: Cap of the Scarlet Savant
objectivesText: In order to create the Cap of the Scarlet Savant, you will be required to bring the following items back to Malyfous Darkhammer: 1 Pristine Hide of the Beast; 5 Frayed Abomination Stitchings; 8 Arcane Crystals; 5 Enchanted Scarlet Thread.
You will also be required to pay 50 gold pieces for the crafting of the item.

5064.name: Grimtotem Spying
objectivesText: Locate and retrieve the three Secret Notes in Darkcloud Pinnacle.

5065.name: The Lost Tablets of Mosh'aru
objectivesText: Bring the Third and Fourth Mosh'aru Tablets to Prospector Ironboot in Tanaris.

5067.name: Leggings of Arcana
objectivesText: In order to create the Leggings of Arcana, you will be required to bring the following items back to Malyfous Darkhammer: 1 Pristine Hide of the Beast; 5 Frayed Abomination Stitchings; 5 Arcanite Bars; 5 Frostwhisper's Embalming Fluid.
You will also be required to pay 50 gold pieces for the crafting of the item.

5068.name: Breastplate of Bloodthirst
objectivesText: In order to create the Breastplate of Bloodthirst, you will be required to bring the following items back to Malyfous Darkhammer: 1 Pristine Hide of the Beast; 10 Frayed Abomination Stitchings; 5 Arcanite Bars; 5 Skin of Shadow.
You will also be required to pay 50 gold pieces for the crafting of the item.

5082.name: Threat of the Winterfall
objectivesText: Donova Snowden in Winterspring wants you to kill 8 Winterfall Pathfinders, 8 Winterfall Den Watchers, and 8 Winterfall Totemics.

5083.name: Winterfall Firewater
objectivesText: Bring the Empty Firewater Flask to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

5084.name: Falling to Corruption
objectivesText: Search the Deadwood furbolg camp in northern Felwood for a clue.

5085.name: Mystery Goo
objectivesText: Report back to Donova Snowden with your findings.

5086.name: Toxic Horrors
objectivesText: Collect 3 Toxic Horror Droplets for Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

5087.name: Winterfall Runners
objectivesText: Find the Winterfall Runners and stop them from delivering their shipment to Winterfall Village.

5088.name: Arikara
objectivesText: Slay Arikara. Bring her remains and the Incendia powder to Motega Firemane in Whitereach Post as proof of your deed.

5093.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
objectivesText: Seek out High Executor Derrington. His base camp is located at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glade and the Undercity.

5094.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
objectivesText: Seek out High Executor Derrington. His base camp is located at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glade and the Undercity.

5095.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
objectivesText: Seek out High Executor Derrington. His base camp is located at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glades and the Undercity.

5096.name: Scarlet Diversions
objectivesText: Proceed to the Scarlet Crusade's base camp between Felstone Field and Dalson's Tears and destroy their command tent.
Place the Scourge banner at the camp, and then return to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5098.name: All Along the Watchtowers
objectivesText: Using the Beacon Torch, mark each tower in Andorhal; you will need to stand in the doorway of the tower to successfully mark it.
Once all four towers are marked, return the Beacon Torch to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5103.name: Hot Fiery Death
objectivesText: Someone in this world must know what to do with these gauntlets. Good luck!

5121.name: High Chief Winterfall
objectivesText: Donova Snowden in Winterspring wants you to defeat High Chief Winterfall.

5123.name: The Final Piece
objectivesText: Bring the Crudely-written Log to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

5124.name: Fiery Plate Gauntlets
objectivesText: Bring Malyfous Darkhammer 6 Enchanted Thorium Bars, 2 Essence of Fire, and 4 Star Rubies. You will also need to turn in your Unfired Plate Gauntlets.

5126.name: Lorax's Tale
objectivesText: Speak with Lorax. Listen to what he has to say.

5127.name: The Demon Forge
objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Spire and find Goraluk Anvilcrack. Slay him and then use the Blood Stained Pike upon his corpse. After his soul has been siphoned, the pike will be Soul Stained.
You must also find the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate.
Return both the Soul Stained Pike and the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate to Lorax in Winterspring.

5128.name: Words of the High Chief
objectivesText: Take the Crudely-written Log to Kelek Skykeeper in southern Felwood.

5142.name: Little Pamela
objectivesText: Find Pamela Redpath.

5145.name: Dragonscale Leatherworking
objectivesText: Bring 2 Tough Scorpid Breastplates, 2 Tough Scorpid Gloves, and 10 Worn Dragonscales to Thorkaf Dragoneye in the Badlands.
Completing this quest will give you access to the Dragonscale Leatherworking arts.
The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Elemental Leatherworking and Tribal Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

5146.name: Elemental Leatherworking
objectivesText: Bring 2 Heart of Fire, 2 Globe of Water, 2 Core of Earth, and 2 Breath of Wind to Brumn Winterhoof in the Arathi Mountains.
Completing this quest will give you access to the Elemental Leatherworking arts.
The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Tribal Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

5147.name: WANTED: Arnak Grimtotem
objectivesText: Slay Arnak Grimtotem and bring proof of your deed to Cliffwatcher Longhorn in Freewind Post.

5148.name: Tribal Leatherworking
objectivesText: Bring a Wild Leather Vest and a Wild Leather Helmet to Se'Jib in Stranglethorn Vale.
Completing this quest will give you access to the Tribal Leatherworking arts.
The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Elemental Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

5149.name: Pamela's Doll
objectivesText: Find Pamela's doll.

5151.name: Hypercapacitor Gizmo
objectivesText: Slay the beast and bring back the Hypercapacitor Gizmo and Panther Cage Key to Wizlo Bearingshiner.

5152.name: Auntie Marlene
objectivesText: Speak with Marlene, south of the Ruins of Andorhal.

5153.name: A Strange Historian
objectivesText: Bring Joseph's Wedding Ring to Chromie.

5154.name: The Annals of Darrowshire
objectivesText: Bring the Annals of Darrowshire to Chromie in Andorhal.

5155.name: Forces of Jaedenar
objectivesText: Enter Jaedenar and slay 4 Jaedenar Hounds, 4 Jaedenar Guardsmen, 6 Jaedenar Adepts, and 6 Jaedenar Cultists before returning to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

5156.name: Verifying the Corruption
objectivesText: Seek out and destroy 2 Entropic Beasts and 2 Entropic Horrors while exploring Shatter Scar Vale. After checking to see if the craters there are still filled with corrupt fel water, return to Taronn Redfeather in Felwood.

5157.name: Collection of the Corrupt Water
objectivesText: Take the Empty Canteen to the Moon Well in the center of Jaedenar and fill it before returning to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

5158.name: Seeking Spiritual Aid
objectivesText: Take the Corrupt Moon Well Water to Islen Waterseer in the Barrens.

5159.name: Cleansed Water Returns to Felwood
objectivesText: Take the Purified Moon Well Water to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

5160.name: The Matron Protectorate
objectivesText: Travel to Winterspring and find Haleh. Give her Awbee's scale.

5161.name: Wrath of the Blue Flight
objectivesText: Speak with Haleh if you wish to continue.

5162.name: Wrath of the Blue Flight
objectivesText: Speak with Jeziba in the Plaguelands. He resides in Andorhal.

5163.name: Are We There, Yeti?
objectivesText: Take Umi's Mechanical Yeti and scare her friends with it:
Legacki in Everlook (Winterspring)
Sprinkle in Gadgetzan (Tanaris)
Quixxil in Marshal's Refuge (Un'Goro Crater)
When you are done, bring the Mechanical Yeti back to Umi.

5164.name: Catalogue of the Wayward
objectivesText: Read from the Catalogue of the Wayward.

5165.name: Dousing the Flames of Protection
objectivesText: Using the Purified Moon Well Water, douse the flames of the four braziers of protection within Shadow Hold in Felwood, then return to Greta Mosshoof in the Emerald Sanctuary.

5166.name: Breastplate of the Chromatic Flight
objectivesText: To forge the Breastplate of the Chromatic Flight, you will be required to bring the following items to Jeziba the 'Sculptor':
1 Chromatic Carapace.
10 Brilliant Chromatic Scales.
10 Blood of Heroes.
10 Frayed Abomination Stitchings.

5167.name: Legplates of the Chromatic Defier
objectivesText: To forge the Legplates of the Chromatic Defier, you will be required to bring the following items to Jeziba the 'Sculptor':
1 Chromatic Carapace.
10 Brilliant Chromatic Scales.
10 Blood of Heroes.
5 Skin of Shadow.

5168.name: Heroes of Darrowshire
objectivesText: Bring Davil's Libram and Redpath's Shield to Carlin Redpath.

5181.name: Villains of Darrowshire
objectivesText: Bring the Skull of Horgus and the Shattered Sword of Marduk to Carlin Redpath at Light's Hope Chapel.

5202.name: A Strange Red Key
objectivesText: Search through Jaedenar to discover what the Blood Red Key is used for.

5203.name: Rescue From Jaedenar
objectivesText: Escort Arko'narin to where Lightforge and her equipment are being held, and then protect her as you escape Shadow Hold. Afterwards, seek out Jessir Moonbow in Felwood to let her know what's happened to her friends.

5204.name: Retribution of the Light
objectivesText: Return to Jaedenar and kill the succubus Rakaiah before finding the Remains of Trey Lightforge.

5206.name: Marauders of Darrowshire
objectivesText: Bring 5 Resonating Skulls and the Mystic Crystal to Carlin Redpath in Eastern Plaguelands.

5210.name: Brother Carlin
objectivesText: Bring the Extended Annals of Darrowshire to Carlin Redpath in Eastern Plaguelands.

5211.name: Defenders of Darrowshire
objectivesText: Free 15 Darrowshire Spirits and return to Carlin Redpath.

5212.name: The Flesh Does Not Lie
objectivesText: Recover 10 Plagued Flesh Samples from Stratholme and return them to Betina Bigglezink. You suspect that any creature in Stratholme would have said flesh sample.

5213.name: The Active Agent
objectivesText: Travel to Stratholme and search the ziggurats. Find and return new Scourge Data to Betina Bigglezink.

5214.name: The Great Ezra Grimm
objectivesText: Find Ezra Grimm's smoke shop in Stratholme and recover a box of Grimm's Premium Tobacco. Return to Smokey LaRue when the job is done.

5228.name: The Scourge Cauldrons
objectivesText: Speak with Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5229.name: Target: Felstone Field
objectivesText: Go to Felstone Field in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there. It may have a key that will allow access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Felstone Field Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

5230.name: Return to the Bulwark
objectivesText: Bring the Filled Felstone Field Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5231.name: Target: Dalson's Tears
objectivesText: Go to Dalson's Tears in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Dalson's Tears Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

5232.name: Return to the Bulwark
objectivesText: Bring the Filled Dalson's Tears Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5233.name: Target: Writhing Haunt
objectivesText: Go to the Writhing Haunt in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Writhing Haunt Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

5234.name: Return to the Bulwark
objectivesText: Bring the Filled Writhing Haunt Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at The Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5235.name: Target: Gahrron's Withering
objectivesText: Go to Gahrron's Withering in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Gahrron's Withering Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

5236.name: Return to the Bulwark
objectivesText: Bring the Filled Gahrron's Withering Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5241.name: Uncle Carlin
objectivesText: Find Carlin Redpath.

5242.name: A Final Blow
objectivesText: Kill Moora and Salia, and bring Shadow Lord Fel'dan's Head to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

5243.name: Houses of the Holy
objectivesText: Travel to Stratholme, in the north. Search the supply crates that litter the city and recover 5 Stratholme Holy Water. Return to Leonid Barthalomew the Revered when you have collected enough of the blessed fluid.

5251.name: The Archivist
objectivesText: Travel to Stratholme and find Archivist Galford of the Scarlet Crusade. Destroy him and burn down the Scarlet Archive.

5262.name: The Truth Comes Crashing Down
objectivesText: Take the Head of Balnazzar to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff in the Eastern Plaguelands.

5263.name: Above and Beyond
objectivesText: Venture to Stratholme and destroy Baron Rivendare. Take his head and return to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff.

5264.name: Lord Maxwell Tyrosus
objectivesText: Speak with Lord Maxwell Tyrosus. He is inside the church.

5265.name: The Argent Hold
objectivesText: Open the Argent Hold and claim your reward.

5281.name: The Restless Souls
objectivesText: Find Egan. You only know that he was last seen around Stratholme.

5282.name: The Restless Souls
objectivesText: Use Egan's Blaster on the ghostly and spectral citizens of Stratholme. When the restless souls break free from their ghostly shells, use the blaster again - freedom will be theirs!
Free 15 Restless Souls and return to Egan.

5301.name: The Art of the Armorsmith
objectivesText: To become an armorsmith, you must make the following items and return them to Okothos: 4 Ornate Mithril Helms, 2 Ornate Mithril Boots, 1 Ornate Mithril Breastplate.

5302.name: The Way of the Weaponsmith
objectivesText: To become a Weaponsmith, you must make the following items and return them to Borgosh: 4 Moonsteel Broadswords, 4 Massive Iron Axes, 2 Heavy Mithril Axes, and 2 Big Black Maces.

5305.name: Sweet Serenity
objectivesText: Travel to Stratholme and kill the Crimson Hammersmith. Recover the Crimson Hammersmith's Apron and return to Lilith.

5306.name: Snakestone of the Shadow Huntress
objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay Shadow Hunter Vosh'gajin. Recover Vosh'gajin's Snakestone and return to Kilram.

5307.name: Corruption
objectivesText: Find the Black Guard Swordsmith in Stratholme and destroy him. Recover the Insignia of the Black Guard and return to Seril Scourgebane.

5341.name: Barov Family Fortune
objectivesText: Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Alexi Barov when you have completed this task.

5342.name: The Last Barov
objectivesText: Travel to Chillwind Camp - Alliance territory - and assassinate Weldon Barov. Take his head and return to Alexi Barov.
Be warned, Weldon will probably be well protected by Alliance scum.

5361.name: Family Tree
objectivesText: Deliver Cliffwatcher Longhorn Report to Nataka Longhorn at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace.

5381.name: Hand of Iruxos
objectivesText: Retrieve the Demon Box from Thunder Axe Fortress, and return it, along with the Demon Pick to Taiga Wisemane in Shadowprey Village.

5382.name: Doctor Theolen Krastinov, the Butcher
objectivesText: Find Doctor Theolen Krastinov inside the Scholomance. Destroy him, then burn the Remains of Eva Sarkhoff and the Remains of Lucien Sarkhoff. Return to Eva Sarkhoff when the task is complete.

5384.name: Kirtonos the Herald
objectivesText: Return to the Scholomance with the Blood of Innocents. Find the porch and place the Blood of Innocents in the brazier. Kirtonos will come to feast upon your soul.
Fight valiantly, do not give an inch! Destroy Kirtonos and return to Eva Sarkhoff.

5385.name: The Remains of Trey Lightforge
objectivesText: Return the Remains of Trey Lightforge to Jessir Moonbow in Felwood.

5386.name: Catch of the Day
objectivesText: Talk to Jinar'Zillen at Shadowprey Village, and then bring Nataka Longhorn 2 Bloodbelly fish.

5441.name: Lazy Peons
objectivesText: Use the Foreman's Blackjack on Lazy Peons when they're sleeping. Wake up 5 peons, then return the Foreman's Blackjack to Foreman Thazz'ril in the Valley of Trials.

5461.name: The Human, Ras Frostwhisper
objectivesText: Travel to the Arathi Highlands, to the ruins of Stromgarde. Search Stromgarde for a Keepsake of Remembrance. If you find such an item, return with it to Magistrate Marduke.

5462.name: The Dying, Ras Frostwhisper
objectivesText: Travel to Light's Hope in Eastern Plaguelands and seek out Leonid Barthalomew the Revered. Show him the Keepsake of Remembrance and tell him all that you have discovered.

5463.name: Menethil's Gift
objectivesText: Travel to Stratholme and find Menethil's Gift. Place the Keepsake of Remembrance upon the unholy ground.

5464.name: Menethil's Gift
objectivesText: Take the Soulbound Keepsake to Leonid Barthalomew in Eastern Plaguelands.

5465.name: Soulbound Keepsake
objectivesText: Return to Magistrate Marduke in Caer Darrow. Show him the Soulbound Keepsake.

5466.name: The Lich, Ras Frostwhisper
objectivesText: Find Ras Frostwhisper in the Scholomance. When you have found him, use the Soulbound Keepsake on his undead visage. Should you succeed in reverting him to a mortal, strike him down and recover the Human Head of Ras Frostwhisper. Take the head back to Magistrate Marduke.

5481.name: Gordo's Task
objectivesText: Collect 3 Gloom Weed and deliver them to Junior Apothecary Holland in the Brill graveyard.

5482.name: Doom Weed
objectivesText: Collect 10 Doom Weed and deliver them back to Junior Apothecary Holland.

5501.name: Bone Collector
objectivesText: Bring 10 Kodo Bones from the Kodo Graveyard to Bibbly F'utzbuckle at Kormek's Hut.

5502.name: A Warden of the Horde
objectivesText: Return your ward to the Orgrimmar orphanage by handing in the Orcish Orphan Whistle to Orphan Matron Battlewail in the Valley of Honor.

5504.name: Mantles of the Dawn
objectivesText: Bring 10 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Hasana at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5513.name: Mantles of the Dawn
objectivesText: Bring 10 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Breechlock at Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands.

5514.name: Mold Rhymes With...
objectivesText: Bring the Imbued Skeletal Fragments and 15 gold coins to Krinkle Goodsteel in Gadgetzan.

5515.name: Krastinov's Bag of Horrors
objectivesText: Locate Jandice Barov in the Scholomance and destroy her. From her corpse recover Krastinov's Bag of Horrors. Return the bag to Eva Sarkhoff.

5517.name: Chromatic Mantle of the Dawn
objectivesText: Bring 25 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Breechlock at Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands.

5518.name: The Gordok Ogre Suit
objectivesText: Bring 4 Bolts of Runecloth, 8 Rugged Leather, 2 Rune Threads, and Ogre Tannin to Knot Thimblejack. He is currently chained inside the Gordok wing of Dire Maul.

5522.name: Leonid Barthalomew
objectivesText: Bring the Frozen Eggs to Leonid Barthalomew in the Eastern Plaguelands.

5524.name: Chromatic Mantle of the Dawn
objectivesText: Bring 25 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Hasana at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5526.name: Shards of the Felvine
objectivesText: Find the Felvine in Dire Maul and acquire a shard from it. Chances are you'll only be able to procure one with the demise of Alzzin the Wildshaper. Use the Reliquary of Purity to securely seal the shard inside, and return it to Rabine Saturna in Nighthaven, Moonglade.

5527.name: A Reliquary of Purity
objectivesText: Travel to Silithus and search for a Reliquary of Purity within the ruins of Southwind Village. If you are able to find it, return with it to Rabine Saturna in Nighthaven, Moonglade.

5529.name: Plagued Hatchlings
objectivesText: Kill 20 Plagued Hatchlings, then return to Betina Bigglezink at the Light's Hope Chapel.

5531.name: Betina Bigglezink
objectivesText: Bring the Frozen Eggs to Betina Bigglezink.

5534.name: Kim'jael's "Missing" Equipment
objectivesText: Find Some Rune that the naga have in their possession in the Ruins of Eldarath and return it to Kim'jael in Azshara.

5535.name: Spiritual Unrest
objectivesText: Destroy 6 Highborne Apparitions and 6 Highborne Lichlings before returning to Loh'atu in Azshara.

5536.name: A Land Filled with Hatred
objectivesText: Kill 6 Haldarr Satyr, 2 Haldarr Tricksters, 2 Haldarr Felsworn and then return to Loh'atu on the border of Ashenvale.

5542.name: Demon Dogs
objectivesText: Slay 20 Plaguehound Runts, 5 Plaguehounds and 5 Frenzied Plaguehounds. Return to Tirion Fordring when the task is complete.

5543.name: Blood Tinged Skies
objectivesText: Slay 30 Plaguebats and return to Tirion Fordring.

5544.name: Carrion Grubbage
objectivesText: Seek out the Carrion Grubs and Devourers of the region. Slay them and harvest their meat. Return to Tirion Fordring when you have gathered 15 Slabs of Carrion Worm Meat.

5561.name: Kodo Roundup
objectivesText: Bring five Tamed Kodos and the Kodo Kombobulator back to Smeed Scrabblescrew at Scrabblescrew's Camp.

5581.name: Portals of the Legion
objectivesText: Banish 6 Portals at Mannoroc Coven and return to Taiga Wisemane at Shadowprey Village.

5582.name: Healthy Dragon Scale
objectivesText: Bring the Healthy Dragon Scale to Betina Bigglezink at the Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.

5601.name: Sister Pamela
objectivesText: Find Pamela Redpath in Darrowshire.

5642.name: Shadowguard
objectivesText: Speak to Ur'kyo in Orgrimmar.

5643.name: Shadowguard
objectivesText: Speak to Ur'kyo in Orgrimmar.

5644.name: Dark Sacrifice
objectivesText: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.

5646.name: Dark Sacrifice
objectivesText: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.

5648.name: Garments of Spirituality
objectivesText: Find Grunt Kor'ja and heal her wounds using Lesser Heal (Rank 2). Afterwards, grant her Power Word: Fortitude and then return to Tai'jin at Razor Hill.

5649.name: In Favor of Spirituality
objectivesText: Speak to Tai'jin in Durotar.

5650.name: Garments of Darkness
objectivesText: Find Deathguard Kel and heal his wounds using Lesser Heal (Rank 2). Afterwards, grant him Power Word: Fortitude and then return to Dark Cleric Beryl in Brill.

5651.name: In Favor of Darkness
objectivesText: Speak to Dark Cleric Beryl in Tirisfal Glades.

5654.name: Hex of Weakness
objectivesText: Speak to Ur'kyo in Orgrimmar.

5655.name: Hex of Weakness
objectivesText: Speak to Ur'kyo in Orgrimmar.

5656.name: Hex of Weakness
objectivesText: Speak to Ur'kyo in Orgrimmar.

5657.name: Hex of Weakness
objectivesText: Speak to Ur'kyo in Orgrimmar.

5660.name: Touch of Weakness
objectivesText: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.

5661.name: Touch of Weakness
objectivesText: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.

5662.name: Touch of Weakness
objectivesText: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.

5663.name: Touch of Weakness
objectivesText: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.

5691.name: <NYI> <TXT> In the Dark it was Created

5692.name: <NYI> In the Dark It was Created
objectivesText: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.

5693.name: <NYI> In the Dark It was Created
objectivesText: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.

5705.name: <NYI> No Longer a Shadow
objectivesText: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.

5706.name: <NYI> No Longer a Shadow
objectivesText: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.

5708.name: <NYI> Flirting With Darkness
objectivesText: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.

5709.name: <NYI> Flirting With Darkness
objectivesText: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.

5721.name: The Battle of Darrowshire
objectivesText: Place the Relic Bundle at the Darrowshire town square.
Prevent Davil Lightfire's death until the death of Horgus.
Prevent Captain Redpath's death until Redpath the Corrupted appears.
Defeat Redpath the Corrupted.
Speak with the spirit of Joseph Redpath when he appears at the town square, then speak with Pamela at her home.

5722.name: Searching for the Lost Satchel
objectivesText: Search Ragefire Chasm for Maur Grimtotem's corpse and search it for any items of interest.

5723.name: Testing an Enemy's Strength
objectivesText: Search Orgrimmar for Ragefire Chasm, then kill 8 Ragefire Troggs and 8 Ragefire Shaman before returning to Rahauro in Thunder Bluff.

5724.name: Returning the Lost Satchel
objectivesText: Take the Grimtotem Satchel to Rahauro in Thunder Bluff.

5725.name: The Power to Destroy...
objectivesText: Bring the books Spells of Shadow and Incantations from the Nether to Varimathras in Undercity.

5726.name: Hidden Enemies
objectivesText: Bring a Lieutenant's Insignia to Thrall in Orgrimmar.

5727.name: Hidden Enemies
objectivesText: Take the Lieutenant's Insignia to Neeru Fireblade and speak to him. Gauge if he believes you are a member of the Burning Blade and then return to Thrall in Orgrimmar.

5728.name: Hidden Enemies
objectivesText: Kill Bazzalan and Jergosh the Invoker before returning to Thrall in Orgrimmar.

5729.name: Hidden Enemies
objectivesText: Speak to Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar.

5730.name: Hidden Enemies
objectivesText: Speak to Thrall in Orgrimmar and tell him what you've learned.

5741.name: Sceptre of Light
objectivesText: Get the Sceptre of Light and then return it to Azore Aldamort at the tower in Ethel Rethor.

5742.name: Redemption
objectivesText: Listen to what Tirion Fordring has to say.

5761.name: Slaying the Beast
objectivesText: Enter Ragefire Chasm and slay Taragaman the Hungerer, then bring his heart back to Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar.

5762.name: Hemet Nesingwary
objectivesText: Take Kravel's Crate to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn.

5763.name: Hunting in Stranglethorn
objectivesText: Bring Roon's Kodo Horn to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn.

5781.name: Of Forgotten Memories
objectivesText: Travel to the Undercroft - at the southernmost section of the Eastern Plaguelands - and recover Taelan's Hammer. Return to Tirion Fordring upon completion of your objective.

5802.name: Fire Plume Forged
objectivesText: Take the Skeleton Key Mold and 2 Thorium Bars to the top of Fire Plume Ridge in Un'Goro Crater. Use the Skeleton Key Mold by the lava lake to forge the Unfinished Skeleton Key.
Bring the Unfinished Skeleton Key to Apothecary Dithers at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5804.name: Araj's Scarab
objectivesText: Destroy Araj the Summoner and bring Araj's Scarab to Apothecary Dithers at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5821.name: Bodyguard for Hire
objectivesText: Escort the Gizelton Caravan past the Kolkar Centaur village. Talk with Smeed at Scrabblescrew's Camp for your reward.

5843.name: Welcome!
objectivesText: Bring the Valley of Trials Gift Voucher to Magga.

5844.name: Welcome!
objectivesText: Bring the Camp Narache Gift Voucher to Vorn Skyseer.

5845.name: Of Lost Honor
objectivesText: Travel to Northdale, in the northeastern region of the Eastern Plaguelands, and recover the Symbol of Lost Honor. Return to Tirion Fordring upon completion of your objective.

5846.name: Of Love and Family
objectivesText: Travel to island of Caer Darrow, in the south-central region of the Plaguelands, and look for any clues as to the whereabouts of the painting.

5847.name: Welcome!
objectivesText: Bring the Deathknell Gift Voucher to Claire Willower in Deathknell.

5848.name: Of Love and Family
objectivesText: Travel to Stratholme, in the northern part of the Plaguelands. It is in the Scarlet Bastion that you will find the painting 'Of Love and Family,' hidden behind another painting depicting the twin moons of our world.
Return the painting to Tirion Fordring.

5861.name: Find Myranda
objectivesText: Travel to Uther's Tomb, located in the southern Plaguelands. Show Myranda the Hag Tirion's Gift.

5862.name: Scarlet Subterfuge
objectivesText: Speak to Myranda to gain the Scarlet Illusion. Travel to Hearthglen while under the Scarlet Illusion and deliver Tirion's Gift to Highlord Taelan Fordring.
Hearthglen is to the north, Taelan should be inside of Mardenholde Keep.

5863.name: The Dunemaul Compound
objectivesText: Andi Lynn in Gadgetzan wants you to destroy the Dunemaul Compound by killing 10 Dunemaul Brutes, 10 Dunemaul Enforcers, and Gor'marok the Ravager.

5881.name: Calling in the Reserves
objectivesText: Maggran wishes you to deliver a letter to Grish Longrunner at the Great Lift in the Barrens.

5893.name: Coldtooth Supplies
objectivesText: Bring 10 Coldtooth Supplies to the Horde Quatermaster in Frostwolf Keep.

5901.name: A Plague Upon Thee
objectivesText: Use the Empty Termite Jar on the Termite Mounds in Eastern Plaguelands. After you've gathered 100 Plagueland Termites, return to Mickey Levine at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

5902.name: A Plague Upon Thee
objectivesText: Find someplace suitable in the center of the Northridge Lumber Mill in Western Plaguelands to place the Barrel of Plagueland Termites.

5922.name: Moonglade
objectivesText: Use the spell "Teleport: Moonglade" to travel to Moonglade. When you arrive, speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.

5926.name: Heeding the Call
objectivesText: Speak with Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff.

5927.name: Heeding the Call
objectivesText: Speak with Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff.

5928.name: Heeding the Call
objectivesText: Speak with Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff.

5930.name: Great Bear Spirit
objectivesText: Seek out the Great Bear Spirit in northwestern Moonglade and learn what it has to share with you about the nature of the bear. When finished, return to Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven, Moonglade.

5932.name: Back to Thunder Bluff
objectivesText: Return to Thunder Bluff and speak with Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise.

5941.name: Return to Chromie
objectivesText: Take the Bundle of Relics to Chromie in Andorhal.

5942.name: Hidden Treasures
objectivesText: Bring Joseph's Key to Joseph's Chest.

5943.name: Gizelton Caravan
objectivesText: Escort the Gizelton Caravan through Mannoroc Coven. Talk with Smeed at Scrabblescrew's Camp for your reward.

5944.name: In Dreams
objectivesText: Escort Taelan Fordring out of Hearthglen.

5961.name: The Champion of the Banshee Queen
objectivesText: Speak with Nathanos Blightcaller in the Eastern Plaguelands. He is said to have taken up residence at the Marris Stead.

6002.name: Body and Heart
objectivesText: Use the Cenarion Lunardust on the Moonkin Stone between Mulgore and the Barrens to bring forth Lunaclaw. From there, you must face Lunaclaw and earn the strength of body and heart it possesses.
Speak with Turak Runetotem in Thunder Bluff when you are done.

6004.name: Unfinished Business
objectivesText: Kill 2 Scarlet Medics, 2 Scarlet Hunters, 2 Scarlet Magi and 2 Scarlet Knights before returning to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.

6021.name: Zaeldarr the Outcast
objectivesText: Bring Zaeldarr's Head to Caretaker Alen at Light's Hope Chapel.

6022.name: To Kill With Purpose
objectivesText: Travel to Corin's Crossing to the east and slaughter the Scourge that inhabit the town. Collect 7 pieces of Living Rot in under 10 minutes. Use the Mortar and Pestle to grind the Living Rot into Coagulated Rot.

6023.name: Unfinished Business
objectivesText: Kill Huntsman Radley and Cavalier Durgen before returning to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.

6024.name: Hameya's Plea
objectivesText: Kill Infiltrator Hameya. Use his key on the Mound of Dirt behind the Undercroft.

6025.name: Unfinished Business
objectivesText: Enter Hearthglen and find a high vantage point from which you can see the town and gauge the Scarlet Crusade's forces, then return to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.

6026.name: That's Asking A Lot
objectivesText: Smokey LaRue wants you to get 2 Thorium Bars, 1 Golden Rod, 8 Hi-Explosive Bombs, and 8 Unstable Triggers.
You will have to find a blacksmith and an engineer for these items.

6027.name: Book of the Ancients
objectivesText: Get the Book of the Ancients and return it to Azore Aldamort at the tower in Ethel Rethor.

6029.name: The Everlook Report
objectivesText: Deliver the Everlook Report to Argent Officer Garush at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

6030.name: Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff
objectivesText: Deliver the book, "Studies in Spirit Speaking", to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff at Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands.

6031.name: Runecloth
objectivesText: Bring 30 Runecloth to Meilosh in Timbermaw Hold.

6032.name: Sacred Cloth
objectivesText: Bring 2 Mooncloth to Meilosh in Timbermaw Hold.

6041.name: When Smokey Sings, I Get Violent
objectivesText: Travel to Plaguewood, northwest of Light's Hope. Destroy 8 Scourge Structures by using Smokey's Special Compound at the Mark of Detonation planted inside each building. Smokey has had the Ziggurats and Slaughterhouses marked.
Once you plant the bomb, leave the building and marvel at your handiwork.
By the way, Smokey's Special Compound is rather... unstable.

6042.name: Un-Life's Little Annoyances
objectivesText: Slay 20 Noxious Plaguebats and 10 Monstrous Plaguebats. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller when you are finished.

6061.name: Taming the Beast
objectivesText: Use the Taming Rod to tame an Adult Plainstrider. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.

6062.name: Taming the Beast
objectivesText: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Dire Mottled Boar. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Thotar in Razor Hill.

6065.name: The Hunter's Path
objectivesText: Speak with Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.

6066.name: The Hunter's Path
objectivesText: Speak with Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.

6067.name: The Hunter's Path
objectivesText: Speak with Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.

6068.name: The Hunter's Path
objectivesText: Speak with Thotar at Razor Hill.

6069.name: The Hunter's Path
objectivesText: Speak with Thotar at Razor Hill.

6070.name: The Hunter's Path
objectivesText: Speak with Thotar at Razor Hill.

6081.name: Training the Beast
objectivesText: Speak with Ormak Grimshot in Orgrimmar.

6082.name: Taming the Beast
objectivesText: Use the Taming Rod to tame an Armored Scorpid. Practice your skills, then return to Thotar at Razor Hill.

6083.name: Taming the Beast
objectivesText: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Surf Crawler. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Thotar at Razor Hill.

6087.name: Taming the Beast
objectivesText: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Prairie Stalker. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.

6088.name: Taming the Beast
objectivesText: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Swoop. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.

6089.name: Training the Beast
objectivesText: Speak with Holt Thunderhorn on Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff.

6126.name: Lessons Anew
objectivesText: Travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.

6127.name: The Principal Source
