objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring 3 Greater Shadow Protection Potions to Mirda in the Magram Village in Desolace.

92755.name: Mysterious Mysticism
objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring 3 Greater Mystic Essences to Halea in the Gelkis Village in Desolace.

92814.name: I Need a Tailor
objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring a White Bandit Mask to Molkar in the Gelkis Village in Desolace.

92817.name: Leather Technique
objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring a Barbaric Harness to Talra in the Gelkis Village in Desolace.

92818.name: Big, No, MASSIVE Iron Axes
objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring 2 Massive Iron Axes to Grolkar in the Magram Village in Desolace.

92833.name: Ve'han's Fall
objectivesText: Use the Staff of the Mountain to strip Ve'han Talongrasp of his stolen power, then destroy him.

92842.name: A Cousin Abroad
objectivesText: Find the missing cousin somewhere on Mount Hyjal.

92844.name: Mountain of Bones
objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring 426 Gently Cursed Bones to Orgrul south of the Magram Village in Desolace.

92847.name: Corrupting Tears
objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring 3 Petrified Bark and 3 Imbued Tears back to Orgrul.

92859.name: Shroud of the Winter Wilds
objectivesText: Bring 5 Winterspring Chimaera Fur and 5 Winterspring Owl Feathers to Evie Whirlbrew.

92871.name: In Service of Zephras
objectivesText: Report to Valennia Stormfist and let her know that the Windshapers are with them in their fight against the Al'Aketh.

92873.name: Proof of Concept
objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram Clan, then bring 426 Well Cursed Bones from a successful ritual back to Orgrul.

92878.name: Lost for Words
objectivesText: Bring proof of Namida Grimtotem's demise to Blaise Montgomery at Camp Mojache.

92880.name: Return to Valanaar
objectivesText: Bring Yorna's Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.

92881.name: The High Elder's Request
objectivesText: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.

92893.name: No Mercy for the Weak
objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram Clan, and slay 5 Gelkis Captives scattered around the Valley of Bones. Return to Orgrul after the task is complete.

92894.name: Bone Raising
objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram Clan, and use the Enhanced Necromancy Staff to fully raise undead that are struggling to emerge throughout the Valley of Bones. Return to Orgrul once the Magram army has grown.

92914.name: Strange Pylons
objectivesText: Explore Shen'dralas in an effort to find other pylons like the one you found.

92947.name: Making Our Move
objectivesText: Slay 7 Al'Aketh Guardians, 7 Al'Aketh Spiritcallers, and 7 Al'Aketh Blademasters, then report to Hyusaa Quickbreeze at the Shrine of Akir.

92959.name: The Dying Ancients
objectivesText: Hunt down and destroy the corrupted ancient Sunderbark, then plant a seed in his remains.

92960.name: Siphoned Ephemeral Essence
objectivesText: Retrieve 6 Ephemeral Essences for Elaena Moonwhisper.

93016.name: A Brief History Lesson
objectivesText: Speak with Mordent Evenshade in Shen'dralas for information about the crystals you repaired.

93030.name: The Knight of Mourning
objectivesText: Speak with the Knight of Mourning to learn more about his unfinished quest.

93034.name: Valley of Bones
objectivesText: Improve your reputation with the Gelkis, and locate Nerlokh near the Valley of Bones far east of Gelkis Village.

93035.name: Ravaging Ravagers
objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis Clan and slay 6 Undead Ravagers, then return to Nerlokh at the southern entrance to Valley of Bones.

93036.name: Infiltrating the Cult
objectivesText: Speak with Sania Silverstream in Shen'dar Village.

93037.name: Outing Outcasts
objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis Clan, and bring 1 Necromantic Garb to Nerlokh at the entrance of the Valley of Bones.

93041.name: Facing the Truth
objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis Clan, and bring an Accursed Skull and Gelkis Necromantic Garb to Uthek the Wise in Gelkis Village.

93045.name: Test Your Theory
objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and dispel the necromantic curse present on the Accursed Skull. Once successful, report back to Nerlokh near the Valley of Bones.

93058.name: Saving Our Own
objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis clan, and rescue 5 Gelkis Captives within the Valley of Bones. Return to Nerlokh near the entrance when you are done.

93062.name: Bone Burying
objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis Clan, and dispel the curses from 8 failed summons throughout the Valley of Bones.

93065.name: Prepare for Battle
objectivesText: Speak with Valennia Stormfist in the Gustberry Lowlands.

93066.name: Bristleback Retreat
objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and slay quilboar at Bristleback Retreat. Then report to Hagiak at the Magram Front on the other side of Valley of Bones in Desolace.

93072.name: Long-Term Solutions
objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram clan and slay 2 Outcast Scouts, 6 Outcast Marauders, and 8 Outcast Necromancers then return to Hagiak at the Magram Front.

93090.name: What Comes Next
objectivesText: Speak with Ayessa Dawnsinger when you are prepared to leave Zephras Isle.

93122.name: Checking Things Out
objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and investigate centaur points of interest within Shen'dralas. Then return to Nerlokh at the entrance of Valley of Bones with your findings.

93125.name: Going Home
objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and escort Rokren out of the Outcast Hideaway. Then inform Nerlokh near the Valley of Bones about what happened.

93127.name: Summit Sentries
objectivesText: Reactivate the sentinel stones north, west, and south around the Blackthorne cultists.

93128.name: Khan Jehn
objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and slay Khan Jhen at Magram Village. Once you have succeeded, report to Uthek the Wise in Gelkis Village in Desolace.

93129.name: Threat of Starvation
objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring 6 Stolen Supplies back to Hagiak at the Magram Front.

93159.name: The Strange Hermit
objectivesText: Speak with the Strange Hermit in the Shadowgale Forest and learn more about him.

93160.name: The Forest's Bounty
objectivesText: Gather 8 Shadowgale Acorns in Shadowgale Forest.

93161.name: The Ancient Hilt
objectivesText: Find someone who would be interested in the Ancient Hilt you found in the ruins of Ban'aethal.

93165.name: Mercy Falls on Deaf Ears
objectivesText: Collect 5 Al'Aketh Cultist's Ears from the Al'Aketh cultists in Shadowgale Forest, the Shrine of Akir, or Gustberry Lowlands.

93172.name: Free the Hollows
objectivesText: Destroy 10 Wind Hollows in Shadowgale Forest.

93176.name: My Little Friends
objectivesText: Use the items contained in the Entomology Starter Kit to find and catch an Arbor Tarantula, Hay Weevil Specimen, and a Flesh Picker.

93188.name: Return to Orgrul
objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and report back to Orgrul near the northern entrance to Valley of Bones.

93196.name: Khan Jehn
objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram and perform a necromancy ritual to resurrect Khan Jehn. The ritual site can be found in a tent at the central lake of Magram Village.

93197.name: Mending Communications
objectivesText: Take mail parcels from Sebelia at the summit camp on Mount Hyjal to Innkeeper Vizzie in Everlook.

93225.name: Carved Centaur Totems
objectivesText: Acquire 5 Carved Centaur Totems by slaying centaur of any clan throughout Desolace, then return them to Gurda Wildmane at Ghost Walker Post.

93269.name: Top of the Post
objectivesText: Take mail from Everlook up to Innkeeper Sebelia on the summit of Mount Hyjal.

93317.name: Crab Season
objectivesText: Collect 6 pieces of Windsong Crawler Meat.

93318.name: WANTED: Vulgara the Insatiable
objectivesText: Kill Vulgara the Insatiable in the Shen'dar Highlands and bring her head to Danarii Bellowveil.

93319.name: Pilfered Windstones
objectivesText: Collect 10 Pilfered Windstones from the Highlands Bandits in the Shen'dar Highlands.

93320.name: Tower Defense
objectivesText: Report to Yorana Windyreed at the eastern watchtower in the Gustberry Lowlands.

93341.name: Forlorn Gardens
objectivesText: Investigate the Forlorn Gardens near Shen'dralas and then return to Mithera at the nearby temple.

93362.name: What They've Done to My Peonies
objectivesText: Cull plants in the Forlorn Garden and then return to Mithera at Shen'dralas.

93394.name: Meeting the Magister
objectivesText: Locate Magister Kirandis inside the temple of Shen'dralas.

93404.name: Rot and Regret
objectivesText: Venture to Maraudon and recover a Vial of Earth Song Water and return it to Woodwyrd at the Forlorn Gardens in Desolace.

93406.name: Unfrozen Deliveries
objectivesText: Find 4 pieces of Missing Mail in the hills north of Everlook and bring it back to Innkeeper Vizzie.

93407.name: A Thorn in the Paw
objectivesText: Find thorn seeds in the forests at the summit of Mount Hyjal and bring them back to Tiala Whitemane.

93422.name: Blackthorne Blackout
objectivesText: Kill the Blackthorne Courier and confiscate her message.

93429.name: Blood of My Blood
objectivesText: Slay 10 Lost Ones in the Fallow Sanctuary.

93430.name: Taking the Bait Back
objectivesText: Find the Lost One Fisherman who stole Pelluk's lure, and take it back.

93444.name: Bait the Beast
objectivesText: Kill a Nightsaber Guardian, then bait out and kill Ghansurok using the Nightsaber Guardian haunch on the northern ridge of the summit.
Return with the heart of the chimaera.

93450.name: Phantasmal Problems
objectivesText: Take Vindael's unfinished sword and figure out a way to usher it into the spirit realm, then return the Phantasmal Blade to him at Shen'dralas.

93464.name: The Visiting Mage
objectivesText: Find the mage in Desolace who knows about the power of draenethyst.

93465.name: Notes on Draenethyst
objectivesText: Take Gimashi's notes on Draenethyst, and bring them back to Azore Aldamort.

93510.name: Wake Memories
objectivesText: Find the anchor on Lake Everstill the War Veteran remembers from childhood.

93521.name: Challenger of the Gods
objectivesText: Take Ve'han's Research Notes to Tiala Whitemane.

93546.name: Spectral Iron Ore
objectivesText: Search for Spectral Iron Deposits around Shen'dralas and collect 10 Spectral Iron Ore. Return to Vindael in Shen'dralas once you have found enough.

93547.name: A Thorny Solution
objectivesText: Plant thorn seeds near the inn, the storage tower, and the grouping of trees at the loyalist druid camp.

93551.name: Praise
objectivesText: Use the Embroidered Scabbard to meet the Veteran of the Third War in Mount Hyjal near the broken cannon in Mourning's Rest.

93552.name: Harvesting Windstones
objectivesText: Collect 15 Windstone Clusters from Raw Windstones in Thendal Grove.

93567.name: Ends Meet
objectivesText: Allow the Veteran of the Third War to tell his story at the broken cannon in Mourning's Rest.

93568.name: Partially Digested Collar
objectivesText: Return the Partially Digested Collar to someone who knows about it. Presumably, they can be found in or near Shen'dralas in Desolace.

93572.name: To Serve The Draenei
objectivesText: Protect the draenei refugees as they pass through Kum'isha's rift to Outland. None of the refugees may die.

93574.name: Corpsefeeder's Carapace
objectivesText: Find someone interested in Corpsefeeder's Carapace.

93584.name: Cult Closure
objectivesText: Kill 10 Blackthorne Adepts and 10 Wild-branded Cultists.

93594.name: Word of the Woods
objectivesText: Find Woodwyrd in the Forlorn Gardens at Shen'dralas in the Desolace.

93601.name: Passing the Blame
objectivesText: Seek out a quilboar of significance at the Bristleback Retreat.

93604.name: Agamaggan's Blood
objectivesText: Venture to Razorfen Downs and acquire Virulent Blood of Agamaggan, then return it to Kog'thug the Brave at Bristleback Retreat in the Desolace. Kog'thug felt it worth reminding that the Blood of Agamaggan inside Razorfen Kraul would not be sufficient.

93606.name: Not on Squealing Terms
objectivesText: Quell the quilboar's quarrel by bringing Quolga a Benevolent Bouquet and the Virulent Blood of Agamaggan. The flowers to make the bouquet can be acquired at the Forlorn Gardens, near Shen'dralas in the Desolace.

93609.name: Forlorn Necklace
objectivesText: Bring the Forlorn Necklace to Mithera at the temple of Shen'dralas in the Desolace.

93615.name: Kits and Cats
objectivesText: Find Shalla'kal's kittens in the wilds of Mount Hyjal.

93617.name: Prey and Predator
objectivesText: Dissuade stags from acting as predators.

93644.name: Tattered Journal
objectivesText: The text suggests the author of this journal may be somewhere in Shen'dralas.

93663.name: Lost in Transit
objectivesText: Find the missing courier, and ensure Dar's shipment is delivered to the Harborage.

93678.name: Abridged Notes on Draenethyst
objectivesText: Take Azore's transcribed notes back to Magtoor at the Harborage in Swamp of Sorrows.

93679.name: Visions of Another
objectivesText: Watch Onku's vision with Magtoor.

93680.name: Key to the City
objectivesText: Acquire the Dalaran Sewer Key for Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill.

93684.name: The Found One
objectivesText: Find the draenei searching for draenethyst in the Blasted Lands.

93685.name: To Serve Kum'isha
objectivesText: Find a Flawless Draenethyst Sphere in the Blasted Lands, and bring it to Kum'isha the Collector.
Be warned, this gem is one of the rarest crystals in all of Azeroth. Any creature in these lands could be holding a Flawless Draenethyst Sphere.

93686.name: Kum'isha's Endeavors
objectivesText: Find and return a Flawless Draenethyst Sphere to Kum'isha the Collector.

93735.name: The Broken Construct
objectivesText: Find Riaani Nightwind on the west side of Valanaar.

93736.name: Unwelcome Spirits
objectivesText: Gather 10 Wind Hollow Essences from Wind Hollows in the Shadowgale Forest.

93737.name: The Broken Construct
objectivesText: Speak with Riaani Nightwind and listen to what he has to say.

93738.name: The Broken Construct
objectivesText: Report back to Ayessa Dawnsinger in Valanaar.

93739.name: Exploring the Horde
objectivesText: Speak with Nazgrel in Grommash Hold to receive further instructions. Use the instructions received to locate and speak with Vol'jin, Cairne Bloodhoof, and Lady Sylvanas Windrunner.

93740.name: Blood for Blood
objectivesText: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Windstone Charms from the corpses of Al'Aketh cultists in the Gustberry Lowlands.

93746.name: A Firm Response
objectivesText: Confront Belathaan Brightwish along the road to the Shrine of Akir.

93747.name: Violence Into Verdure
objectivesText: Plant the Enchanted Seeds near the Ruined Ballista, the Ruined Catapult, and the Ruined Flying Machine.

93759.name: The Bounty of Nature
objectivesText: Collect 2 Hyjal Venison Cuts from untainted Hyjal Stags and 6 Scarlet Dart Tubers for the hermit's stew.

93773.name: The Pact
objectivesText: Report back Ketharas on Mount Hyjal.

93786.name: A Message in Blood
objectivesText: Slay 12 Meadowsbrook Farmhands, then return to Krom'rosh with news of your success.

93787.name: Food for the Taking
objectivesText: Steal 6 Feed Satchels from the Alliance farm in Meadowsbrook then return to Krom'rosh.

93788.name: Borrowed Blades
objectivesText: Retrieve 10 Woodworker's Axe from the lumberjacks at Turner's Logging Camp for Kreza Darkthorn in Rog'mar.

93825.name: Barkbound Blessings
objectivesText: Gather 12 clumps of Moonveil Moss and return to Suma Mossmane.

93826.name: Deal Dread to Deadwood
objectivesText: Defeat 8 Deadwood Totemics and 8 Deadwood Fel-Tenders and return to Elder Pinespeaker.

93827.name: Windswept Wards
objectivesText: Collect 16 Enchanted Harpy Amulet and return to Thobon Sapclaw.

93828.name: Herbs of the Hollow
objectivesText: Collect 10 Dried Hanging Herbs from around Barkskin Burrow and return them to Fennar Mossmane.

93830.name: Water of Hyjal
objectivesText: Fill a waterskin provided by Fennar Mossmane at the pond outside of the Deadwood Furbolg den.

93831.name: Sweetpaw Jam
objectivesText: Gather 30 Bear Berries from Hyjal and return to Osi Mistpaw.

93832.name: Shatter the Stonewatchers
objectivesText: Destroy 6 Eternal Sentry gargoyles in the destroyed Alliance base in upper Hyjal and return to Elder Mistpaw.

93833.name: Wicked Wisdom
objectivesText: Bring 5 owl bodies to Elder Pinespeaker in Barkskin Burrow in Hyjal.

93834.name: Burrow Beetles
objectivesText: Gather 10 Burrow Beetle Bits for Dala Fairmaw.

93836.name: The Fate of Zephras
objectivesText: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.

93848.name: Work Well Done
objectivesText: Return to Ketharas and inform him of what occurred at the Summit of Eternity.

93926.name: The Western Watch
objectivesText: Find Peacekeeper Vaaniel at the western watchtower.

93927.name: A Last Request
objectivesText: Collect the note you found near the dead peacekeeper and read it to determine your next steps.

93948.name: Deliver the Signet
objectivesText: Deliver the Shadowsong Family Signet to Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.

93949.name: Bugged
objectivesText: Kill Skyhoppers in Valanaar until you've eliminated 8 Enchanted Skyhoppers.

93951.name: A Little Beauty
objectivesText: Collect 8 Hippogryph Down feathers in the Shen'dar Highlands.

93952.name: Balance Through Strength
objectivesText: Defeat 9 Deadwood Den Guardians and return to Brerufa.

93958.name: The Inner Sanctum
objectivesText: Speak with Valennia Stormfist inside the inner sanctum at the Shrine of Akir.

93971.name: Farholde Scouting Report
objectivesText: Bring the report to Krom'rosh at Rog'mar.

93976.name: The Goblin Trader
objectivesText: Deliver the blade to Kreza Darkthorn's acquaintance at the docks east of Rog'mar.

94003.name: The Skybreaker Bulwark
objectivesText: Reclaim the Skybreaker Bulwark from Zaal Stormshield at the Shrine of Akir.

94006.name: The Great Ursera Spirit
objectivesText: Speak with Urs'endris near the falls northeast of Valanaar.

94007.name: Taming the Beast
objectivesText: Report to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.

95183.name: Step One: Rock

95254.name: WANTED: Trapclaw

95284.name: The Elite of the Elite

objectivesText: Look for the Bolder'ok ogre in the nearby cave.

95432.name: Rise Up!

95433.name: Death to the Executioner
objectivesText: Collect the Executioner's Mace from Executioner Morg in the Twilight Shroud for Clugfist in Bolder'ok.

95568.name: Seeds for a New Season

objectivesText: Rescue 12 Hyjal Owl Eggs and bring them to Ketharas.

objectivesText: Destroy 5 Twilight Ritual Circles found throughout the caves underneath Sunnyglade.

95611.name: Rites of Respect

95697.name: Changing Tastes
objectivesText: Enter the Excavation Sites in the Wetlands and bring back Thicket Raptor Meat.

95748.name: The Gurubashi Legends of Old

95766.name: Fine Feathered Friend

95769.name: Threading a Solution

95770.name: Locating the Lost City

96104.name: Song of the Strider

objectivesText: Bring 4 samples of Glade Viper Venom to Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.

96109.name: A Hunter's Quiver
objectivesText: Gather 6 Prized Lion Hides for Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.

96130.name: Chakuyak
objectivesText: Defeat Chakuyak and bring back her pelt.

objectivesText: Take the Faintly Glowing Branch to Ketharas.

96136.name: Call of Air
objectivesText: Find Prate Cloudseer in Thousand Needles.

96145.name: Past Wing and Claw
objectivesText: Seek Phoebe Highfeather at the Shrine of Aviana.

96204.name: The Windshaper's Wrath
objectivesText: Accompany Lumina Windsinger and help her escape Fenris Keep.

96209.name: The Ancient, Orokai
objectivesText: Seek out Orokai in Moonglade.

96255.name: Amalgamated Marrow
objectivesText: Slay the Awakened Fel Ash Slime.

96259.name: Defending the Dead

96260.name: Stronger than Steel
objectivesText: Gather 3 strands of Crystalline Silk from Gloomrise Spinners.

96261.name: The Broodmother
objectivesText: Kill Broodmother Valraxx at Gloomrise.

96262.name: Prickly Pinecones
objectivesText: Collect 10 Prickly Pinecones under healthy trees.

96294.name: A Darker Truth
objectivesText: Bring the letter you recovered from Broodmother Valraxx to Muln Earthfury at Skywatcher Plateau.

96296.name: Fetid Corruption
objectivesText: Find and remove 6 Corrupted Knots from the trees nearby.

96301.name: Power Wash
objectivesText: Enter the Well of Eternity and observe its effects on the Venom-dripping Heart.

96302.name: Arch Absolution
objectivesText: Take Marn's incense and allow the smoke to ward the air around Archimonde's remains.

96303.name: Memory Mist
objectivesText: Use the Enchanted Branch to release 5 wisps around Nordrassil.

96321.name: The Dying God
objectivesText: Find someone on Mount Hyjal who may be interested in the Faintly Glowing Staff.

96322.name: A Revenge Now Bitter
objectivesText: Speak to Felflick.

96334.name: Blood Red Bandanas

96335.name: The Man in the Iron Chains
objectivesText: Recover the Alcaz Shackle Key from The Questioner in Alcaz Prison.

96337.name: More Valuable Than Gold
objectivesText: Use the note provided by Mason Connery to find his hidden treasure.

96339.name: Legacy Reward: Replica Ironforge Air Rifle

96369.name: Bad News for Folkar
objectivesText: Report back to Commander Folkar.

96395.name: An Ancient Grudge
objectivesText: Put the spirit of Faldrim Anvilmar to rest and then return to the Ghostly Attendant in the Hall of Thanes.

96435.name: A Fitting End

96550.name: Battle Recall
objectivesText: Use the Embroidered Scabbard to speak with the war veteran and hear his story at the overlook in Elderwild.

96558.name: Soldier's Solace
objectivesText: Recover the Battle Cache buried on Mount Hyjal.

96561.name: Last Wishes
objectivesText: Find the fishing pond near the destroyed Alliance lumbermill in the Cradle of Tranquility.

96604.name: The Great Outdoors
objectivesText: Sit near Brakk's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.

96605.name: The Great Outdoors
objectivesText: Sit near Kaga's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.

96607.name: The Great Outdoors
objectivesText: Sit near Eleanor's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.

96616.name: Herbs for the Bruised and Weary
objectivesText: Collect 12 Hyjal Silphium.

96622.name: A Rest Without Pain
objectivesText: Deliver the Hyjal Silphium Poultice to Enho and Maruke.

96638.name: The Adventurer
objectivesText: Speak to Raan Wildwind near Shen'dar Village.

96646.name: Camping 101: Cooking
objectivesText: Speak with Zerril Softbreeze in Shen'dar Village to learn to become a cook.

96652.name: The Adventurer
objectivesText: Bring the journal to Brakk near Razor Hill.

96655.name: Camping 101: Cooking
objectivesText: Speak with Cook Torka in Razor Hill to learn to become a cook.

96656.name: The Adventurer
objectivesText: Speak to Eleanor Shackleton near Brill.

96658.name: Camping 101: Cooking
objectivesText: Speak with William Pickman in Brill to learn to become a cook.

96659.name: The Adventurer
objectivesText: Deliver the Supply Bundle to Kaga Wildhoof near Bloodhoof Village.

96661.name: Camping 101: Cooking
objectivesText: Speak with Pyall Silentstride in Bloodhoof Village to learn to become a cook.

96666.name: Burrow Bonding
objectivesText: Raise your reputation with the Barkskin Burrow to Friendly.

96774.name: Ancient Gurubashi Idol
objectivesText: Recover an Ancient Gurubashi Idol from the Drowned City.

96775.name: Zum'rah's Head
objectivesText: Slay Witch Doctor Zum'rah and bring Zum'rah's Head to Mazu'kon in Mulgore.

96776.name: An'she's Radiance
objectivesText: Recover the crystal known as An'she's Radiance from Maraudon.

96784.name: Master of Disguise
objectivesText: While disguised as a member of the Syndicate, find someone inside Stromgarde Keep who knows about the secret deal.

96785.name: Ain't No Telling
objectivesText: Find something within Stromgarde Keep to convince Anastasia to give up details of the secret deal.

96822.name: For Honor

96825.name: This Fruit Could Bite Back
objectivesText: Cook Torka in Razor Hill wants you to collect 8 Prickly Pear Fruit from the Razormane Grounds west of town.

96830.name: Farsight Guided

96873.name: A Pain in the Neck

96874.name: This Is Spinal Axe

96875.name: Beasts of Thunder Ridge
objectivesText: Kamari in Orgrimmar wants you to collect 5 Rough Lizard Hide from beasts in Thunder Ridge, along with 2 Cured Light Hides.

96876.name: Ukor's Lost Pack

96877.name: Halikor's Hoof

96896.name: A Righteous Cause

96898.name: Remnants of War

96899.name: Bandarion Keep

96912.name: Field of Honor: Week 1

96913.name: Field of Honor: Week 2

96914.name: Field of Honor: Week 3
objectivesText: Kill 25 players of the enemy faction in Warsong Gulch.

96930.name: The Capricious Corvid
objectivesText: Return to the Curious Crow.

96931.name: Heading Up the Mountain
objectivesText: Touch the Crow Effigy on the bridge overlooking the Cradle of Tranquility to call the Wild God, Jereman.

96939.name: The Balance of Life and Death

96957.name: Bone Sweet Bone
objectivesText: Collect 20 Sun-Bleached Bones.

96959.name: Blademaster's Bonfires
objectivesText: Light the two bonfires in Dae'gun and return to Yashiro.

96964.name: A Clever Creature

objectivesText: Collect 8 Abandoned Supplies.

96978.name: Violent Venison
objectivesText: Speak to the Wild God, Kala'th.

96979.name: Sacred Refreshment
objectivesText: Fill Galvinquam Leafsyre's drinking gourd at the waterfall ahead.

96983.name: Yashiro's Windwalk
objectivesText: Fight your way through Dae'gun with Yashiro.

96984.name: Heart of Disruption
objectivesText: Collect the Arcane Mote in the City of Dalaran for Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill.

96986.name: The Grave Knight

96987.name: Opportunistic Education
objectivesText: Collect the Founding of Dalaran from the City of Dalaran for Rexxie Copperclutch near the sewer entrance.

96988.name: Source of Power

96989.name: Your First Riding Raptor

96991.name: Trail Assist

96994.name: Your First Riding Wolf

96996.name: Your First Riding Galestrider
objectivesText: Inspect the riding striders to choose your first mount.

96997.name: A Steed in Death as They Were in Life

96998.name: Tribal Colors
objectivesText: Take the War Paint Wrap to someone who may recognize it.

96999.name: Wrap Return
objectivesText: Take the War Paint Wrap to someone in Sen'jin Village.

97000.name: Grain of Memory
objectivesText: Search Hyjal's destroyed Alliance camps for signs of Abigail Sawyer's father, Lawrence.

97001.name: Sawyer's Legacy

97003.name: Chol'aruk the Ravener

97007.name: Wood Remains
objectivesText: Return the notarized Sawyer Family Ledger to Abigail Sawyer in the War Quarter.

97009.name: Maerion's Misery

97010.name: Blind Vengeance

97029.name: Eluvi'ana

objectivesText: Find a key to Wendel's cage, and a disguise for him to sneak out, within the Kurzen compound.

97049.name: Essence of Seeping Slimes
objectivesText: Gather 8 Seeping Slime Essence in the Shaper's Terrace.

97066.name: Tip the Scales - Brownell's Blue Striped Racer

97119.name: Now We're Cooking
objectivesText: Bring 6 Savory Stag Sliders to Ortak Lomgok in Elderwild.

97174.name: A Worthy Endeavor
objectivesText: Speak with Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep in Tirisfal Glades.

97175.name: Due Sacrifice
objectivesText: Travel to Orgrimmar and get High Priest Zayus's Exorcism Censer. You will need to make a donation of 150 gold in order to secure it.

97176.name: Exorcising Terrordale
objectivesText: Use the Exorcism Censer to drive out the tormented spirits in Terrordale. When you have destroyed 25 Terrordale Spirits, return to Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep in Tirisfal Glades.

97177.name: Acts of Mercy
objectivesText: Return the Exorcism Censer to Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep in Tirisfal Glades.

97178.name: Ott of Tarren Mill
objectivesText: Speak with Ott at the village of Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

97179.name: Collection of Goods
objectivesText: Bring 40 Runecloth, 6 Arcanite Bars, 10 Arthas' Tears, 5 Stratholme Holy Water vials, and 150 gold to Ott in Hillsbrad Foothills.

97180.name: Ott's Finest Work
objectivesText: Take the Arcanite Barding to Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep for inspection.

97182.name: An Offering of Vengeance
objectivesText: Acquire special horse feed used for feeding a spirit horse. Nathanos Blightcaller in Eastern Plaguelands may be able to provide such a feed.
Travel to the Dire Maul in Feralas and slay Tendris Warpwood. Doing so will free the Ancient Equine Spirit. Feed it the special horse feed to soothe it.
Lastly, give it the Arcanite Barding and hope that it is willing to provide the needed blessing.

97183.name: Blessed Arcanite Barding
objectivesText: Return with the Blessed Arcanite Barding to Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep in Tirisfal Glades.

97184.name: The Divination Scryer
objectivesText: Bring an Azerothian Diamond and a Pristine Black Diamond to Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep in Tirisfal Glades.

97185.name: Justice and Retribution
objectivesText: Use the Divination Scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement in the Scholomance.  Doing so will bring forth the spirits you must judge. Defeating these spirits will summon forth Death Knight Darkreaver.  Defeat him and reclaim the lost soul of the fallen charger.
Give the Spirit of Retribution and the Blessed Enchanted Barding to Darkreaver's Fallen Charger.

97186.name: Manna-Enriched Horse Feed
objectivesText: Retrieve 20 Enriched Manna Biscuits for Nathanos Blightcaller in Eastern Plaguelands. The Argent Dawn is known as the sole purveyor of the biscuits. You'll also need to provide Blightcaller with 50 gold for his time.

97194.name: Learning to Ride
objectivesText: Learn the Apprentice Riding skill from Kildar.

97196.name: The Coldbringer's Eye
objectivesText: Recover The Coldbringer's Eye from Razorfen Downs.

97197.name: Fragment of the Firelands
objectivesText: Recover a Fragment of the Firelands from Blackrock Depths for Alaana Stormwalker in Mulgore.

97198.name: Blackmaw Magic
objectivesText: Recover a Blackmaw Ritual Totem from Blackmaw Hold.

97200.name: Learning to Ride
objectivesText: Learn the Apprentice Riding skill from Xar'ti.

97203.name: Learning to Ride
objectivesText: Learn the Apprentice Riding skill from Velma Warnam.

97204.name: Learning to Ride
objectivesText: Learn the Apprentice Riding skill from Kar Stormsinger.

objectivesText: Bring Eggs of the Bloodtalon Matriarch to Xar'Ti in Sen'jin Village.

97225.name: Forgotten Loa Idols
objectivesText: Collect 8 Forgotten Loa Idols from the Echo Isles. Bring them to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.

97242.name: Yelmak's Medley
objectivesText: Take some cuttings from the Cattails and Speargrass growing around the water flows in the Valley of Honor and return to Kor'geld in Yelmak's Alchemy and Potions.

97243.name: Call of Fire
objectivesText: Bring the Torch of Dormant Flame to Olariaan Swiftburn at the Shrine of Flames in the Gustberry Lowlands.

97244.name: Call of Fire
objectivesText: Slay Skypriest Faladiel in the Gustberry Lowlands and collect Faladiel's Heart.

97245.name: Call of Fire
objectivesText: Find the home of Kuramaa in the Shen'dar Highlands, and defeat the spirit in combat. Bring Kuramaa's Mask to Olariaan Swiftburn in the Gustberry Lowlands when you are victorious.

97246.name: Meal Appeal
objectivesText: Visit Borstan's Firepit and tell him Thatog wants you to deliver Migi's lunch to him personally.

97249.name: Favorite Food
objectivesText: Bring Migi's Lunch to him behind Grommash Hold.

97250.name: Wrongly Blamed, Justly Corrected
objectivesText: Slay Alliance soldiers encroaching into the Barrens at the border to Dustwallow Marsh, then return to Grunt Logmar at Camp Taurajo.

97253.name: Parts and Pieces
objectivesText: Collect 5 Handfuls of Complicated Parts from the upper pirate camp south of Ratchet, then return to Wrenix the Wretched in Ratchet.

97257.name: Call of Fire
objectivesText: Wait for Olariaan to begin the ritual at the Brazier of Offering and follow his instructions.
You must deliver the Eternal Flame to Valanaar before the timer runs out.

97264.name: Shardtooth Pulling
objectivesText: Remove 12 Elder Shardtooth from nearby areas, then return to Sarna Brownhorn.

97265.name: Hate the Hatefury
objectivesText: Defeat a variety of Hatefury satyr at Sargeron in Desolace and then return to Aka'rai in Shadowprey Village.

97270.name: Brawl at the Maul

97275.name: Whuut's the Rush

97287.name: Shrewd Negotiations

97289.name: Unending Torment
objectivesText: Bring the Head of the Baron to the body of Othmar in the Undercity.

97290.name: Unending Torment
objectivesText: Report your findings to Master Apothecary Faranell in Undercity.

97291.name: Unending Torment
objectivesText: Collect a Toxic Skullcap from Tawny Grisette in the Trade Quarter, Blisterweed near the Herbalism Trainer, and Essence of Agony from the poison vendor in the Rogues' Quarter for Master Apothecary Faranell in Undercity.

97292.name: Unending Torment
objectivesText: Inject the Hissing Serum into the system above Othmar's body for Master Apothecary Faranell.
